detail.abstract: Emotion recognition aims to identify affective categories by analyzing physiological signals and behavioral characteristics and is one of the key research directions in Artificial Intelligence (AI). Addressing the issues of limited unimodal representation capability and insufficiently established cross-modal deep association in existing emotion recognition algorithms, which lead to inadequate accuracy and robustness in complex scenarios, this paper proposes a bimodal emotion recognition algorithm based on deep fusion of speech and image to enhance the accuracy and robustness of emotion recognition by establishing an effective cross-modal interaction and adaptive fusion mechanism. For image modality, Bilinear Interpolation (BI) is used for image scale normalization, followed by an improved Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract deep spatial features. An improved Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) is then employed to compress features, reduce redundancy, and enhance fine-grained details. Finally, an improved Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) performs emotion classification. For speech modality, prosodic features, Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs), geometric features, and attribute features are fused to form a multidimensional acoustic representation, which is subsequently classified using an improved MLP. After unimodal recognition, the outputs of the two modalities are fused at the decision level using a dynamic adaptive weighting strategy to generate the final emotion category and its corresponding probability. The experimental results indicate that, under a unified test set, the accuracy of sentiment recognition in this paper is improved by 14% and 18% respectively compared to single-modality models. Compared to other fusion strategy models, the recognition accuracy is concentrated in the range of 65% to 70%. The deep fusion method proposed in this paper achieves an overall recognition accuracy of 81.18%, which is superior to other methods. This result verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm proposed in this paper in improving the accuracy of sentiment recognition and system robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于语音和图像深度融合的双模态情感识别算法，通过建立跨模态交互和自适应融合机制，解决了现有算法单模态表示能力有限和跨模态关联不足的问题，在统一测试集上达到81.18%的整体识别准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过语音和图像的深度融合来提高情感识别的准确性和鲁棒性？
AI.motivation: 现有情感识别算法存在单模态表示能力有限、跨模态深度关联建立不足的问题，导致在复杂场景下准确性和鲁棒性不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多模态情感识别理论，结合深度学习和特征融合理论，构建语音-图像双模态情感识别框架。
AI.method: 1) 图像模态：双线性插值归一化→改进CNN提取空间特征→改进稀疏自编码器压缩特征→改进MLP分类；2) 语音模态：融合韵律特征、MFCC、几何特征和属性特征→改进MLP分类；3) 决策级融合：使用动态自适应加权策略融合双模态输出。
AI.findings: 1) 相比单模态模型，准确率分别提升14%和18%；2) 相比其他融合策略模型（准确率65%-70%），本文方法达到81.18%的整体识别准确率；3) 验证了算法在提高情感识别准确性和系统鲁棒性方面的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了有效的跨模态交互和自适应融合机制；2) 建立了语音和图像的深度融合框架；3) 发展了动态自适应加权策略用于决策级融合。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一种高准确率（81.18%）的双模态情感识别算法；2) 增强了复杂场景下的系统鲁棒性；3) 为实际情感识别应用提供了有效的技术方案。

title: Unveiling the Mechanisms of Deep Engagement in Rural Short Videos: A Mixed-Methods Study on Bilibili
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Unveiling the Mechanisms of Deep Engagement in Rural Short Videos: A Mixed-Methods Study on Bilibili
detail.abstract: Within China’s rural revitalization framework, a tension exists between algorithmic ”traffic logic” and socially significant ”value logic.” While platforms prioritize shallow metrics, high-effort behaviors—like coin-tipping—signal deep identification yet remain under-researched. This study employs an explanatory sequential mixed-methods design to investigate ”deep engagement” on Bilibili. K-means clustering of 646 videos identified a ”Deep Engagement Cluster” characterized by a disproportionately high coin-tip rate (22.6%). Qualitative analysis reveals two dominant narrative paradigms: altruistic support for the rural elderly and the cultural valorization of traditional crafts. Furthermore, discourse analysis of 34,229 comments demonstrates that deep engagement functions as a tripartite meaning-making practice anchored in moral evaluation, affective resonance, and collective identity. Findings suggest that deep engagement transcends behavioral intensity, manifesting as a form of moral agency and identity performance. Theoretically, the study articulates how micro-narratives translate into macro-social value through a dual-pathway of moral and cultural identification. Practically, it offers insights for algorithmic reform and the promotion of authentic, prosocial rural storytelling.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨中国乡村振兴背景下Bilibili平台的"深度参与"现象，发现打赏行为不仅是高强度参与，更是道德代理和身份认同的表现，揭示了微观叙事通过道德与文化认同转化为宏观社会价值的双重路径。
AI.research_question: 在中国乡村振兴框架下，平台算法驱动的"流量逻辑"与社会意义的"价值逻辑"之间存在何种张力？深度参与（如打赏行为）如何作为道德代理和身份认同的表现形式？微观叙事如何转化为宏观社会价值？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注平台浅层指标，而高努力行为（如打赏）虽能反映深度认同却研究不足。在中国乡村振兴背景下，理解算法逻辑与社会价值逻辑之间的张力至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度参与理论、道德代理理论、身份认同理论、叙事理论、算法逻辑与社会价值逻辑的张力框架。
AI.method: 采用解释性序列混合方法设计：1）K-means聚类分析646个视频识别"深度参与集群"；2）定性分析揭示叙事范式；3）话语分析34,229条评论。
AI.findings: 1）识别出"深度参与集群"，其打赏率高达22.6%；2）发现两种主导叙事范式：对农村老人的利他支持和对传统工艺的文化价值化；3）深度参与作为三重意义建构实践：道德评价、情感共鸣和集体认同。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）阐明深度参与超越行为强度，表现为道德代理和身份认同；2）提出微观叙事通过道德认同和文化认同的双重路径转化为宏观社会价值；3）丰富算法逻辑与社会价值逻辑的张力理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为算法改革提供见解，促进真实、亲社会的乡村叙事；2）为平台设计支持深度参与的功能提供指导；3）为乡村振兴内容创作者提供策略建议。

title: An Integrated Framework for Evaluating Road Network Resilience: Wellington Fault Mw 7.5 Scenario
affiliations: University of Auckland, University of Auckland - Faculty of Engineering and The University of Auckland

detail.title: An Integrated Framework for Evaluating Road Network Resilience: Wellington Fault Mw 7.5 Scenario
detail.abstract: The Wellington region faces significant seismic risk, with a major rupture of the Wellington Fault expected to severely disrupt road network operability. This study applies a simulation-based framework to assess post-disaster road network resilience using a large-scale mesoscopic traffic model of the North Island. The framework integrates multi-source demand estimation and staged recovery scenarios, as well as trip- and corridor-level performance metrics to evaluate accessibility loss and traffic redistribution. Results indicate widespread disruption, with 9%, 5%, and 4% of trips becoming infeasible three days, two weeks and three months post-disaster. Severe congestion emerges on constrained urban detours, while prolonged highway corridor closures isolate the Hutt Valley and Wairarapa. The findings demonstrate the value of simulation-based stress testing for resilience-oriented transport planning.

AI.tldr: 本研究应用基于仿真的框架评估惠灵顿地区地震后道路网络韧性，发现地震将导致大量出行不可行，并引发严重拥堵和区域隔离问题。
AI.research_question: 惠灵顿断层大地震后，道路网络的韧性表现如何？具体来说，出行可行性、拥堵程度和区域可达性会受到怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 惠灵顿地区面临重大地震风险，惠灵顿断层的主要破裂预计会严重破坏道路网络运营能力，需要评估其韧性以支持防灾规划。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于仿真的韧性评估框架，整合多源需求估计和分阶段恢复情景，使用出行和走廊级别的性能指标来评估可达性损失和交通重新分布。
AI.method: 应用大规模中观交通模型（北岛模型），采用仿真框架进行压力测试，分析地震后不同时间点（3天、2周、3个月）的道路网络表现。
AI.findings: 地震后3天、2周和3个月分别有9%、5%和4%的出行变得不可行；受限的城市绕行路线出现严重拥堵；高速公路走廊长期关闭导致哈特谷和怀拉拉帕地区被隔离。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了基于仿真的压力测试在韧性导向交通规划中的价值，提供了评估道路网络灾后性能的系统性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为惠灵顿地区的防灾规划和应急管理提供了具体数据支持，揭示了关键脆弱点和恢复优先级，有助于制定更有效的韧性提升策略。

title: Integrating Pseudocereals into Nigerian Diets: Food Chemistry Approaches to Improve Protein Quality, Micro-Nutrient Bioavailability, and Public Health Outcomes
affiliations: Admiralty University of Nigeria

detail.title: Integrating Pseudocereals into Nigerian Diets: Food Chemistry Approaches to Improve Protein Quality, Micro-Nutrient Bioavailability, and Public Health Outcomes
detail.abstract: Nigeria continues to face persistent nutrition challenges, including protein-energy malnutrition and micronutrient deficiencies, which hinder progress toward Sustainable Development Goal 2 (Zero Hunger). This study applies food chemistry approaches to assess the potential of integrating pseudocereals (quinoa, amaranth, buckwheat) alongside traditional cereals (maize, rice, sorghum) into national nutrition strategies. Nutritional profiling revealed that pseudocereals provide superior amino acid balance, higher micronutrient density, and enhanced antioxidant activity compared to conventional staples. Processing techniques such as fermentation, extrusion, and fortification were shown to improve bioavailability of iron, zinc, and essential amino acids. Findings suggest that incorporating pseudocereals into feeding programs, maternal and child nutrition initiatives, and fortified food products could significantly improve dietary quality and public health. Policy recommendations include incentivizing local cultivation, strengthening supply chains, and promoting awareness of nutritional benefits. By leveraging both cereals and pseudocereals, Nigeria can enhance dietary diversity and advance toward true nutritional security.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了将假谷物（藜麦、苋菜、荞麦）与传统谷物（玉米、水稻、高粱）结合纳入尼日利亚营养策略的潜力，发现假谷物在氨基酸平衡、微量营养素密度和抗氧化活性方面更优，通过适当加工可提高营养素生物利用度，建议通过政策支持促进假谷物应用以改善营养安全。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合假谷物和传统谷物来改善尼日利亚的营养状况，实现可持续的粮食安全？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚持续面临蛋白质-能量营养不良和微量营养素缺乏等营养挑战，阻碍了可持续发展目标2（零饥饿）的实现，需要探索创新的营养改善策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于食品化学和营养学理论，结合可持续粮食系统框架，探讨通过膳食多样化和营养强化改善公共健康的路径。
AI.method: 采用食品化学方法进行营养分析，包括营养成分分析、氨基酸平衡评估、微量营养素密度比较、抗氧化活性测定，并评估发酵、挤压、强化等加工技术对营养素生物利用度的影响。
AI.findings: 假谷物在氨基酸平衡、微量营养素密度和抗氧化活性方面优于传统谷物；适当加工技术可显著提高铁、锌和必需氨基酸的生物利用度；整合假谷物到营养项目中可改善膳食质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家营养改善提供了基于食品化学的实证证据；发展了假谷物与传统谷物协同作用的营养策略理论；丰富了膳食多样化对营养安全影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚营养政策制定提供具体建议；开发了可行的假谷物整合方案；提出了激励本地种植、加强供应链和营养宣传的具体措施；为其他类似国家提供了可借鉴的营养改善模式。

title: IntPatch: Effective Interaction Intensity Decay Encoding for Link Prediction with Position-Aware Patching Continuous-Time Graphs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: IntPatch: Effective Interaction Intensity Decay Encoding for Link Prediction with Position-Aware Patching Continuous-Time Graphs
detail.abstract: Dynamic graph representation learning, as a crucial approach for modeling non-Euclidean spatiotemporal data, holds broad application prospects in domains such as social networks and transportation systems. However, effectively reconciling transient interactions with long-term evolutionary patterns remains challenging due to static nodal encoding paradigms in link prediction. Moreover, positional information induced by fixed patching fundamentally constrains spatiotemporal fine-grained representation. To solve these issues, we proposed the Interaction Intensity Encoding with Position-Aware Patching Continuous-Time Graphs (IntPatch) model. In detail, we devised an interaction intensity decay encoding method, where short-term memory kernels captured transient state transitions while long-term ones handled long-term dependencies. Additionally, we developed a position-aware patching methodology that decoupled neighborhood segmentation and positional encoding via learnable tensor factorization. The architecture employed multi-head attention to capture intra-patch dynamics while maintaining inter-patch coherence through trainable embeddings. Extensive link prediction task experiments on twelve real-world continuous-time graph datasets demonstrated that IntPatch outperformed the baselines, achieving superior performance in both transductive and inductive learning paradigms. To the best of our knowledge, our model achieved the best results on most experimental datasets.

AI.tldr: IntPatch模型通过交互强度衰减编码和位置感知分块方法，解决了连续时间图中瞬时交互与长期演化模式的平衡问题，在12个真实数据集上实现了最先进的链接预测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在连续时间图中有效调和瞬时交互与长期演化模式，同时克服固定分块对时空细粒度表示的限制？
AI.motivation: 现有链接预测方法采用静态节点编码范式，难以平衡瞬时交互与长期演化模式；同时固定分块方法引入的位置信息限制了时空细粒度表示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间图表示学习、交互强度衰减编码理论、位置感知分块方法、可学习张量分解、多头注意力机制。
AI.method: 提出IntPatch模型：1）交互强度衰减编码方法，使用短期和长期记忆核分别捕捉瞬态和长期依赖；2）位置感知分块方法，通过可学习张量分解解耦邻域分割和位置编码；3）多头注意力架构捕捉块内动态并保持块间一致性。
AI.findings: 在12个真实世界连续时间图数据集上的链接预测实验中，IntPatch超越了所有基线方法，在转导式和归纳式学习范式下均取得最优性能，在大多数数据集上达到最佳结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出交互强度衰减编码理论框架，统一处理瞬时和长期依赖；2）建立位置感知分块方法，突破固定分块对时空表示的限制；3）为连续时间图表示学习提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）IntPatch模型在社交网络、交通系统等实际应用中具有广泛前景；2）模型在转导式和归纳式学习场景下均表现优异；3）为动态图分析任务提供了有效的工具。

title: Economic Impacts of Subsea Cable Deployment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Columbia University

detail.title: Economic Impacts of Subsea Cable Deployment
detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of the economic impact of submarine cable (SMC) infrastructure, which is critical for global digital connectivity and carries almost all intercontinental data traffic. Despite their fundamental role in the digital economy, robust evidence on the economic returns of SMC investments is very scarce. To address this, we use a panel dataset of developed countries and causal identification strategies, such as two-way fixed effects models and instrumental variables exploiting exogenous variation from factors like a country's coastline length and legacy market competition. First, our analysis establishes that increased international bandwidth (IBW) capacity resulting from submarine cable deployment significantly improves broadband quality by increasing speeds and reducing latency. We then quantify the impact on broadband demand, finding distinct yet robust demand elasticities for mobile and fixed services. We find that a 1% increase in IBW capacity drives mobile broadband demand up between 0.044% and 0.088%, while the increase for fixed broadband demand is slightly lower at between 0.041% and 0.062%. Finally, we translate these estimates into a simple cost-benefit framework using an illustrative transatlantic cable project connecting Ireland and the United States. This analysis shows that the substantial GDP spillovers — quantified at between US$121.05 billion and US$163.09 billion for the Irish landing site alone — overwhelmingly exceed the total private deployment costs of $180–$260 million. Our findings affirm that SMC deployments generate significant positive externalities and high social returns. While it has been argued that these effects are critical to developing nations lacking infrastructure, our findings indicate this to also be applicable to advanced economies. Consequently, we argue that policymakers in coastal nations have a strong economic incentive to facilitate private investment by reducing regulatory barriers and transaction costs associated with, for example, cable permits and landing stations.

AI.tldr: 该研究实证分析了海底电缆基础设施的经济影响，发现国际带宽容量提升能显著改善宽带质量，增加移动和固定宽带需求，并通过跨大西洋电缆案例证明其产生的GDP溢出效应远超部署成本，对发达国家同样适用。
AI.research_question: 海底电缆基础设施投资对发达国家经济的具体影响是什么？如何量化这些投资带来的宽带质量改善、需求增长和GDP溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 海底电缆承载着几乎所有洲际数据流量，对数字经济至关重要，但关于其投资经济回报的实证证据非常缺乏，特别是对发达国家的影响研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字基础设施经济学、网络外部性理论、成本效益分析框架，以及宽带需求弹性理论。
AI.method: 使用发达国家面板数据，采用双向固定效应模型和工具变量法（利用海岸线长度和历史市场竞争等外生变量），建立因果识别策略，并进行成本效益分析。
AI.findings: 1）国际带宽容量增加显著提升宽带速度并降低延迟；2）移动宽带需求弹性为0.044%-0.088%，固定宽带为0.041%-0.062%；3）爱尔兰-美国跨大西洋电缆案例中，仅爱尔兰登陆点的GDP溢出达1210.5-1630.9亿美元，远超1.8-2.6亿美元的私人部署成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了海底电缆对发达国家的经济影响，扩展了数字基础设施外部性理论的应用范围，证明了网络效应在发达国家同样显著。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沿海国家政策制定者提供实证依据，建议降低监管壁垒和交易成本以促进私人投资；为基础设施投资决策提供成本效益分析框架；证明海底电缆投资具有高社会回报率。

title: Variance-Aware Adaptive Weighting for Diffusion Model Training
affiliations: Kennesaw State University and Kennesaw State University

detail.title: Variance-Aware Adaptive Weighting for Diffusion Model Training
detail.abstract: Diffusion models have recently achieved remarkable success in generative modeling, yet their training dynamics across different noise levels remain highly imbalanced, which can lead to inefficient optimization and unstable learning behavior. In this work, we investigate this imbalance from the perspective of loss variance across log-SNR levels and propose a variance-aware adaptive weighting strategy to address it. The proposed approach dynamically adjusts training weights based on the observed variance distribution, encouraging a more balanced optimization process across noise levels. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves generative performance over standard training schemes, achieving lower Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) while also reducing performance variance across random seeds. Additional analysis, including loss-log-SNR visualization, variance heatmaps, and ablation studies, further reveal that the adaptive weighting effectively stabilizes training dynamics. These results highlight the potential of variance-aware training strategies for improving diffusion model optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对扩散模型训练中不同噪声水平损失方差不平衡的问题，提出了一种方差感知自适应加权策略，通过动态调整训练权重实现更平衡的优化，在CIFAR数据集上取得了更好的生成性能。
AI.research_question: 如何解决扩散模型训练中不同噪声水平（log-SNR）的损失方差不平衡问题，以实现更稳定和高效的优化？
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在生成建模中取得了显著成功，但不同噪声水平的训练动态高度不平衡，这可能导致优化效率低下和学习行为不稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于损失方差分析的理论框架，从log-SNR水平的损失方差角度研究训练不平衡问题，提出方差感知自适应加权策略。
AI.method: 提出方差感知自适应加权策略，根据观测到的方差分布动态调整训练权重，鼓励跨噪声水平的更平衡优化过程。
AI.findings: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的实验表明，该方法相比标准训练方案一致提高了生成性能，获得了更低的Fréchet Inception Distance（FID），同时减少了跨随机种子的性能方差。损失-log-SNR可视化、方差热图和消融研究进一步显示自适应加权有效稳定了训练动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 从损失方差角度深入分析了扩散模型训练不平衡问题，提出了方差感知的训练理论框架，为扩散模型优化提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的方差感知自适应加权策略，能够稳定扩散模型训练，提高生成质量，减少训练方差，为实际应用提供了更可靠的训练方法。

title: From Growth to Strain: Studying the Impacts of Population Growth and Urban Development on Victoria Falls' Water Supply Infrastructure
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Growth to Strain: Studying the Impacts of Population Growth and Urban Development on Victoria Falls' Water Supply Infrastructure
detail.abstract: This study explores the impacts of population and urban growth on water supply infrastructure in Victoria Falls. The city was granted city status on the 9th of December 2020. With a growing tourist economy, increasing internal migration, and visible urban sprawl, Victoria Falls is experiencing pressure on its existing water infrastructure.The Project aimed to gain an understanding of how population and urban growth characteristics affect the capacity and performance of water infrastructure systems to meet increasing demand. The study assessed and evaluated the infrastructure's performance and condition, focusing on storage tanks, pipe networks, and in-network appliances. A combination of assessment and comparative analysis methods was applied, utilizing tools such as Microsoft Excel, EPA Excel-based templates, and Google Earth for data analysis, performance evaluation, and spatial referencing.The research included both quantitative and qualitative investigations, supported by stakeholder consultations and expert interviews across relevant sectors. Findings revealed that population growth and urban development are indeed exerting significant strain on the infrastructure, evidenced by critical stress indicators such as increased turnover rates, rising failure frequencies, and higher vulnerability to contamination and service disruptions.Despite the challenges, the Municipality has implemented a few short-term measures to reduce immediate system shocks; however, these are unsustainable. The study recommends that long-term improvements to infrastructure, including modern technologies, and integrated methods for managing the water supply system, are necessary to enhance resilience and ensure sustainable service delivery. The project concludes with a proposed Integrated Water Resource Management Plan to address immediate needs and future demand

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了维多利亚瀑布城人口增长和城市扩张对供水基础设施的影响，发现现有基础设施面临严重压力，建议采用长期改进措施和综合水资源管理计划来增强系统韧性。
AI.research_question: 人口增长和城市发展特征如何影响供水基础设施系统的容量和性能以满足日益增长的需求？
AI.motivation: 维多利亚瀑布城于2020年12月9日获得城市地位，随着旅游经济增长、内部移民增加和城市扩张明显，现有供水基础设施面临压力，需要了解这些增长特征对基础设施的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施性能评估框架、综合水资源管理理论、城市发展与基础设施关系理论。
AI.method: 采用评估和比较分析方法，结合定量和定性调查，使用Microsoft Excel、EPA Excel模板和Google Earth进行数据分析、性能评估和空间参考，辅以利益相关者咨询和专家访谈。
AI.findings: 人口增长和城市发展确实对基础设施造成显著压力，表现为周转率增加、故障频率上升、污染和服务中断风险增加等关键压力指标。尽管市政当局实施了一些短期措施来减少即时系统冲击，但这些措施不可持续。
AI.theory_contributions: 为城市发展与基础设施关系理论提供了实证支持，特别是在快速城市化背景下供水基础设施的压力机制研究方面做出了贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了长期基础设施改进建议，包括采用现代技术和综合管理方法，并制定了综合水资源管理计划，为维多利亚瀑布城和其他类似城市提供了具体的政策建议和实施方案。

title: Two-stage method for recognition of pavement structural layer in road construction based on low-altitude UAV imagery and convolutional neural network
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Tsinghua University, Tsinghua University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Two-stage method for recognition of pavement structural layer in road construction based on low-altitude UAV imagery and convolutional neural network
detail.abstract: Accurate and efficient progress and quality monitoring of Pavement Structural Layer (PSL) construction is essential for effective management of road construction. Traditional manual inspection is subjective and inefficient, while low-altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery provides rich visual data but requires reliable recognition of PSL. The research question is how to achieve accurate and efficient recognition of PSL in the construction phase based on low-altitude UAV imagery. This paper proposes a two-stage method for the recognition of PSL based on low-altitude UAV imagery. First, an improved Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based binary classification model screens UAV images to identify road-containing samples. Second, an improved DeepLabv3+ model performs fine-grained semantic segmentation of the road-containing samples to recognize PSL. The method achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, facilitating accurate and efficient monitoring of road construction. Future work will explore larger datasets, multimodal data fusion, and more advanced architectures to further enhance robustness and generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于低空无人机影像的两阶段路面结构层识别方法，通过改进的CNN二分类模型筛选包含道路的图像，再使用改进的DeepLabv3+模型进行细粒度语义分割，实现了准确高效的道路施工监控。
AI.research_question: 如何基于低空无人机影像实现施工阶段路面结构层的准确高效识别？
AI.motivation: 传统人工检查方法主观且低效，而低空无人机影像虽然提供了丰富的视觉数据，但需要可靠的路面结构层识别技术来支持道路施工的有效管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算机视觉和深度学习理论，特别是卷积神经网络和语义分割模型在图像识别领域的应用。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：第一阶段使用改进的CNN二分类模型筛选包含道路的无人机图像；第二阶段使用改进的DeepLabv3+模型对筛选出的图像进行细粒度语义分割以识别路面结构层。
AI.findings: 该方法在准确性和效率之间取得了良好的平衡，能够促进道路施工的准确高效监控。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合二分类筛选和细粒度语义分割的两阶段识别框架，为基于无人机影像的施工监控提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的道路施工监控系统，能够替代传统人工检查，提高施工质量监控的客观性和效率，为工程管理提供技术支持。

title: InterFuserDVS: Event-Enhanced Sensor Fusion for Safe RL‑Based Decision Making
affiliations: AGH University of Krakow, AGH University of Krakow, AGH University of Krakow and AGH University of Krakow

detail.title: InterFuserDVS: Event-Enhanced Sensor Fusion for Safe RL‑Based Decision Making
detail.abstract: Autonomous driving systems rely heavily on robust sensor fusion to perceive complex environments.Traditional setups using RGB cameras and LiDAR often struggle in high-dynamic-range scenesor high-speed scenarios due to motion blur and latency. Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS), or eventcameras, offer a paradigm shift by capturing asynchronous brightness changes with microsecondtemporal resolution and high dynamic range. In this paper, we propose an extended architecture of thestate-of-the-art InterFuser model, integrating DVS as an additional modality to enhance perceptionreliability. We introduce a novel token-based fusion strategy that incorporates accumulated eventframes into the transformer-based backbone of InterFuser. Our method leverages the complementarynature of RGB, LiDAR, and DVS data. We evaluate our approach on the Car Learning to Act (CARLA)Leaderboard benchmarks, demonstrating that the inclusion of DVS improves the robustness of thedriving agent, achieving a competitive Driving Score of 77.2 and a superior Route Completion of100%. The results indicate that event-based vision is a promising direction for improving safety andperformance in adverse lighting and dynamic conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种扩展的InterFuser架构，通过集成动态视觉传感器(DVS)作为额外模态来增强自动驾驶感知可靠性。采用新颖的基于token的融合策略将累积事件帧整合到transformer骨干网络中，利用RGB、LiDAR和DVS数据的互补特性。在CARLA基准测试中，该方法实现了77.2的驾驶评分和100%的路线完成率，证明了事件相机在恶劣光照和动态条件下的优势。
AI.research_question: 如何通过集成动态视觉传感器(DVS)来增强自动驾驶系统的感知可靠性，特别是在高动态范围场景和高速场景中？
AI.motivation: 传统自动驾驶系统依赖RGB相机和LiDAR，但在高动态范围场景和高速场景中容易受到运动模糊和延迟的影响。动态视觉传感器(DVS)能够以微秒级时间分辨率和宽动态范围捕获异步亮度变化，为解决这些问题提供了新范式。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 多模态传感器融合理论：利用不同传感器的互补特性增强感知可靠性
2. 事件相机理论：基于亮度异步变化的事件驱动感知机制
3. Transformer架构：用于多模态数据融合的注意力机制
4. 状态最先进的InterFuser模型扩展
AI.method:
1. 扩展InterFuser架构，集成DVS作为第三模态
2. 提出新颖的基于token的融合策略，将累积的事件帧整合到transformer骨干网络中
3. 利用RGB、LiDAR和DVS数据的互补特性进行多模态融合
4. 在CARLA Leaderboard基准上进行评估
AI.findings:
1. DVS的集成显著提高了驾驶代理的鲁棒性
2. 在CARLA基准测试中实现了77.2的驾驶评分
3. 获得了100%的路线完成率
4. 事件视觉在恶劣光照和动态条件下表现出优越性能
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了扩展的InterFuser架构，首次将DVS集成到自动驾驶多模态融合框架中
2. 开发了新颖的基于token的DVS融合策略
3. 验证了事件相机在自动驾驶感知中的理论价值
4. 为多模态传感器融合提供了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供了实际可用的自动驾驶系统增强方案
2. 提高了自动驾驶系统在高动态范围和高速场景中的可靠性
3. 为自动驾驶安全性能提升提供了技术路径
4. 在CARLA基准测试中展示了实际性能改进

title: Nonparametric Minimum-Distance Estimation of Simulation Models
affiliations: Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna di Pisa - Institute of Economics

detail.title: Nonparametric Minimum-Distance Estimation of Simulation Models
detail.abstract: We propose a simulated nonparametric minimum-distance estimator for the estimation of parameters of complex simulation models. To address the limitations of traditional simulation-based econometric techniques in cases where the stochastic equicontinuity condition is violated, we approximate the distance between real-world observations and data simulated from a theoretical model using a series of basis functions, allowing for the estimation of model parameters without relying on specific auxiliary models or moment selection. We study the consistency and rates of convergence of our estimator. We investigate its performance through Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial market data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模拟的非参数最小距离估计器，用于复杂仿真模型的参数估计。该方法通过基函数逼近真实观测数据与理论模型模拟数据之间的距离，避免了传统仿真计量技术中随机等连续性条件被违反的问题，无需依赖特定辅助模型或矩选择。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种稳健的仿真模型参数估计方法，在随机等连续性条件被违反的情况下仍能有效工作？
AI.motivation: 传统基于仿真的计量经济学技术在随机等连续性条件被违反时存在局限性，需要开发不依赖特定辅助模型或矩选择的更稳健估计方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数最小距离估计、仿真计量经济学、基函数逼近理论、随机等连续性条件
AI.method: 提出基于基函数逼近的模拟非参数最小距离估计器，通过蒙特卡洛实验验证性能，并在金融市场数据上进行实证应用。
AI.findings: 估计器具有一致性并研究了收敛速率，蒙特卡洛实验和金融市场数据应用表明该方法在随机等连续性条件被违反时仍能有效工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了不依赖特定辅助模型或矩选择的仿真参数估计新方法；2) 建立了估计器的一致性和收敛速率理论；3) 解决了随机等连续性条件被违反时的估计问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为复杂仿真模型提供了更稳健的参数估计工具；2) 在金融市场等实际应用中具有实用价值；3) 方法实现相对简单，无需预先选择特定矩条件。

title: Theoretical Foundations for Knowledge Value Added (KVA): Mathematical Proofs from Information Theory, Productivity Theory, Econometrics, Managerial Accounting, Economic and Financial Theory
affiliations: Government of the United States of America - Naval Postgraduate School and Government of the United States of America - Naval Postgraduate School

detail.title: Theoretical Foundations for Knowledge Value Added (KVA): Mathematical Proofs from Information Theory, Productivity Theory, Econometrics, Managerial Accounting, Economic and Financial Theory
detail.abstract: This paper develops rigorous theoretical foundations for the Knowledge Value Added (KVA) methodology, developed by Housel and Kanevsky (1995). KVA was later enhanced and incorporated in the Integrated Risk Management (IRM) methodology developed by Mun (2005) that combines Monte Carlo simulation, stochastic portfolio optimization, and strategic real options to make robust forecasts using KVA data. KVA is a process-based approach that measures the economic value of knowledge embedded in organizational processes by: (i) quantifying knowledge using learning time or equivalent ratio scale quantitative proxies; (ii) expressing outputs in common, complexity-adjusted units; (iii) allocating revenue proportionally to embedded knowledge content across subprocesses; and (iv) defining Return on Knowledge (ROK) as a key performance metric that is equivalent to the financial accounting ratio Return on Investment.We show that these core KVA premises are defensible under four well-established bodies of theory: information theory, human capital and production theory, financial valuation (including real options), and econometrics. First, we use Shannon entropy and a learning–information equivalence axiom to justify learning time as a valid ordinal and cardinal measure of knowledge content. Second, we embed knowledge as an explicit factor in a production function and link KVA’s revenue allocation to competitive factor shares and a linear knowledge-based micro technology. Third, we interpret KVA’s ROK as a risk-adjusted return on knowledge capital, demonstrate its consistency with standard NPV rankings, and show how KVA naturally fits into Monte Carlo and real-options valuation of knowledge-intensive portfolios. Fourth, we frame KVA as a constrained one-factor regression model in which normalized knowledge services are the unique driver of process-level revenue, yielding clear econometric hypotheses and validation strategies. The result is a unified theoretical framework that supports KVA as a rigorous, analytically grounded methodology for measuring, valuing, and managing knowledge assets at the process level.Finally, we show the many practical applications of this methodology in measuring the value contributions of information technology and human resources in for-profits (e.g., AT&T) and not-for-profits (e.g., military investments). And conclude with the practical applications of this methodology and its potential implications for resolving current challenges in measuring the return on investment in information technologies (IT), including artificial intelligence (AI).

AI.tldr: 本文为知识价值增值(KVA)方法论建立了严谨的理论基础，将KVA与信息理论、人力资本理论、金融估值和计量经济学等四大理论体系联系起来，为组织流程中的知识资产测量、估值和管理提供了统一的理论框架。
AI.research_question: 知识价值增值(KVA)方法论是否具有坚实的理论基础？如何将KVA与现有的信息理论、生产理论、金融估值理论和计量经济学理论相连接，以支持其作为知识资产测量和管理方法的有效性？
AI.motivation: 知识价值增值(KVA)方法论虽然由Housel和Kanevsky于1995年提出，并被Mun(2005)整合到集成风险管理(IRM)方法中，但缺乏系统的理论基础。当前在测量信息技术(IT)和人工智能(AI)投资回报方面面临挑战，需要建立严谨的理论框架来支持KVA作为知识资产测量的有效方法。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 信息理论：使用香农熵和学习-信息等价公理来证明学习时间作为知识内容的有效序数和基数测量
2. 人力资本与生产理论：将知识作为生产函数的显性因素，将KVA的收入分配与竞争性要素份额和线性知识型微观技术联系起来
3. 金融估值理论：将KVA的ROK解释为风险调整后的知识资本回报，证明其与标准NPV排序的一致性，展示KVA如何融入蒙特卡洛模拟和实物期权估值
4. 计量经济学：将KVA构建为约束单因素回归模型，其中标准化知识服务是流程层面收入的唯一驱动因素
AI.method: 理论构建与整合方法：通过理论推导和逻辑论证，将KVA方法论与四大理论体系建立联系，构建统一的理论框架。具体包括：1) 基于信息理论的公理化推导；2) 生产函数建模；3) 金融估值模型的一致性证明；4) 计量经济学模型构建。
AI.findings:
1. KVA的核心前提在四大理论体系下是站得住脚的
2. 学习时间可以作为知识内容的有效测量指标
3. KVA的收入分配方法符合生产理论中的要素分配原则
4. ROK指标与标准金融估值方法一致
5. KVA可以构建为可检验的计量经济学模型
6. 形成了支持KVA作为严谨方法论的理论框架
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为KVA方法论建立了系统的理论基础
2. 将KVA与四大成熟理论体系相连接
3. 证明了学习时间作为知识测量指标的理论合理性
4. 建立了知识作为生产函数因素的理论模型
5. 提供了ROK与金融估值方法一致性的理论证明
6. 构建了KVA的计量经济学理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为测量信息技术和人力资源的价值贡献提供了方法论支持
2. 可应用于营利组织(如AT&T)和非营利组织(如军事投资)
3. 为解决当前测量IT投资回报的挑战提供了潜在方案
4. 为人工智能(AI)投资回报测量提供了理论基础
5. 支持组织在流程层面测量、估值和管理知识资产

title: G-ADASYN: Adaptive Oversampling for Imbalanced Learning on Mixed-type Datasets using Gower Distance and Heuristic Rules
affiliations: University of Concepción, University of Concepción, University of Concepción, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Concepción

detail.title: G-ADASYN: Adaptive Oversampling for Imbalanced Learning on Mixed-type Datasets using Gower Distance and Heuristic Rules
detail.abstract: This paper introduces G-ADASYN, an adaptive oversampling method designed for imbalanced datasets containing mixed-type attributes. While the original ADASYN algorithm relies on Euclidean distance to identify nearest neighbors, this assumption can distort similarity relationships when categorical variables are present. To address this limitation, G-ADASYN incorporates the Gower distance, allowing similarity to be computed directly on heterogeneous attributes without requiring numerical encodings. As a result, the proposed approach generates synthetic minority samples that better preserve the underlying structure of mixed datasets. Experimental results on several benchmark datasets show that G-ADASYN produces statistically coherent synthetic samples and achieves competitive or improved classification performance compared with traditional oversampling methods.

AI.tldr: G-ADASYN是一种针对包含混合类型属性的不平衡数据集的自适应过采样方法，它使用Gower距离替代欧氏距离来更好地处理分类变量，从而生成更符合数据结构的合成少数类样本。
AI.research_question: 如何为包含混合类型属性（数值型和分类型）的不平衡数据集开发有效的过采样方法，以解决传统方法在处理分类变量时的局限性？
AI.motivation: 原始ADASYN算法依赖欧氏距离来识别最近邻，但当数据集中包含分类变量时，这种假设会扭曲相似性关系。需要一种能够直接处理异构属性而不需要数值编码的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应合成过采样（ADASYN）理论，Gower距离理论（用于混合类型数据的相似性度量），不平衡学习理论。
AI.method: 提出G-ADASYN方法，将Gower距离整合到ADASYN框架中，允许直接在异构属性上计算相似性，无需数值编码。通过实验在多个基准数据集上验证方法效果。
AI.findings: G-ADASYN能够生成统计上一致的合成样本，相比传统过采样方法，在分类性能上达到竞争性或改进的结果，更好地保留了混合数据集的底层结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将Gower距离整合到ADASYN框架中，扩展了过采样方法对混合类型数据的适用性；2）提出了直接处理异构属性而不需要数值编码的新方法；3）丰富了不平衡学习理论在处理混合类型数据方面的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为实际应用中常见的混合类型不平衡数据集提供了有效的过采样工具；2）提高了分类器在混合类型不平衡数据集上的性能；3）避免了分类变量数值编码可能引入的偏差。

title: Matching manure management technology to farm scale: a sustainable pathway for reducing non-CO₂ GHG emissions from the livestock sector
affiliations: Northwest A&F University, Northwest A&F University, Northwest A&F University, Northwest Agricultural and Forestry University, Peking University and Northwest A&F University

detail.title: Matching manure management technology to farm scale: a sustainable pathway for reducing non-CO₂ GHG emissions from the livestock sector
detail.abstract: Manure management represents one of the most controllable sources of non-CO₂ greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from the livestock sector, yet the emission implications of ongoing structural transformation remain poorly understood. Here, we construct a emission inventory for China's swine, dairy, and beef cattle sectors across 31 provinces during 2005–2020 using IPCC Tier 2 methodology with climate-adjusted conversion factors. We further develop a novel five-factor Logarithmic Mean Divisia Index (LMDI) decomposition model that explicitly separates scale structure effects from management efficiency effects, and design a two-dimensional scenario framework to quantify mitigation potential through 2030. Results show that total non-CO2 GHG emissions followed an inverted U-shaped trajectory, rising from 148.3 Mt CO2-eq in 2005 to a peak of 190.6 Mt CO2-eq in 2014, then declining to 139.9 CO2-eqby 2020. Decomposition analysis reveals that producer exit reduced cumulative emissions by 304.59 Mt CO2-eq, while scale expansion increased emissions by 271.88 Mt CO2-eq, together dominating emission dynamics. Notably, management efficiency contributed minimally to mitigation—instead increasing CH₄ emissions by 32.64 Mt CO2-eq despite widespread adoption of modern facilities, reflecting a concurrent transition toward liquid-based manure systems with higher methane conversion factors. Scenario analysis demonstrates that integrating large-scale consolidation with anaerobic digestion technology could achieve maximum CH₄ reductions of 78.5% for swine, 91.9% for dairy cattle, and 90.3% for beef cattle. These findings reveal a fundamental disconnect between industrial consolidation and emission mitigation, underscoring that realizing the mitigation potential of livestock modernization requires coordinated policies aligning technology adoption with farm scale, rather than assuming consolidation alone will deliver emission reductions.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了中国畜牧业非CO₂温室气体排放，发现2005-2020年间排放呈倒U型轨迹，生产者退出是减排主因，而规模化扩张增加排放，管理效率改善反而增加了甲烷排放。研究强调需要协调规模化与技术采用的政策，而非单纯依赖产业整合来实现减排。
AI.research_question: 中国畜牧业非CO₂温室气体排放的结构转型影响是什么？如何通过协调规模化与技术采用实现减排潜力？
AI.motivation: 粪污管理是畜牧业最可控的非CO₂温室气体排放源，但结构转型对排放的影响尚不清楚，需要理解产业整合与减排之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: IPCC Tier 2方法学、五因素LMDI分解模型（明确分离规模结构效应与管理效率效应）、二维情景分析框架
AI.method: 构建2005-2020年中国31个省份猪、奶牛、肉牛行业的排放清单，使用气候调整转换因子，应用LMDI分解模型，设计2030年减排潜力情景分析
AI.findings: 1) 排放呈倒U型轨迹：2005年148.3 Mt CO₂-eq，2014年峰值190.6 Mt CO₂-eq，2020年降至139.9 Mt CO₂-eq；2) 生产者退出减少排放304.59 Mt CO₂-eq，规模扩张增加排放271.88 Mt CO₂-eq；3) 管理效率改善反而增加甲烷排放32.64 Mt CO₂-eq；4) 规模化与厌氧消化技术结合可实现最大减排：猪78.5%、奶牛91.9%、肉牛90.3%
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了产业整合与减排之间的根本脱节；2) 发展了分离规模结构效应与管理效率效应的LMDI分解模型；3) 提出了协调规模化与技术采用的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供实证依据：单纯产业整合不能实现减排；2) 提出规模化与厌氧消化技术协调的具体减排方案；3) 为畜牧业现代化提供可操作的减排路径

title: Predictive modelling and optimization of green solvent extraction and isolation of antioxidants from rosemary leaves: Integrating RSM, GPR, and ANN
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Predictive modelling and optimization of green solvent extraction and isolation of antioxidants from rosemary leaves: Integrating RSM, GPR, and ANN
detail.abstract: Designing sustainable extraction processes is a key challenge for replacing conventional solvents with greener alternatives. Here, ethyl lactate (EL), a fully bio-based and biodegradable solvent, was evaluated for the targeted extraction of carnosic acid, carnosol, and rosmarinic acid from dried rosemary leaves. Extraction parameters were systematically investigated using Response Surface Methodology (RSM), Gaussian Process Regression (GPR), and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) to identify the optimal conditions. ANN exhibited the highest predictive performance (ANN > RSM > GPR) and guided process optimization, yielding 2.90 ± 0.05 % w/w carnosic acid under 70 °C for 30 min. Comparative experiments with ethanol, conducted under literature optimized conditions, confirmed that EL achieved comparable performance, with carnosic acid purity of 18.4 ± 0.11 % w/w versus 19.21 ± 0.5 % w/w for ethanol, while mass yield was higher for ethanol (15.25 ± 0.00 %) than for EL (10.58 ± 0.00 %). Notably, the EL process reduced carbon emissions to 210 g CO₂/g extract and maintained antioxidant stability in canola oil. These findings demonstrate that EL, combined with data-driven optimization, provides an efficient, and greener approach for industrial production of natural antioxidants, supporting resilient and environmentally responsible food ingredient.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了生物基溶剂乳酸乙酯（EL）从迷迭香叶中提取天然抗氧化剂（鼠尾草酸、鼠尾草酚、迷迭香酸）的效果，采用ANN等数据驱动方法优化提取工艺，发现EL与乙醇性能相当但碳排放更低，为绿色提取工艺提供了新方案。
AI.research_question: 乳酸乙酯（EL）作为生物基绿色溶剂，能否有效替代传统溶剂（如乙醇）从迷迭香叶中提取天然抗氧化剂（鼠尾草酸、鼠尾草酚、迷迭香酸）？
AI.motivation: 传统溶剂在提取工艺中存在环境问题，需要开发可持续的绿色替代方案。乳酸乙酯（EL）作为完全生物基、可生物降解的溶剂，具有替代潜力但需要系统评估其提取性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色化学原理、可持续提取工艺理论、数据驱动的工艺优化方法（响应面法、高斯过程回归、人工神经网络）。
AI.method: 采用响应面法（RSM）、高斯过程回归（GPR）和人工神经网络（ANN）系统研究提取参数，通过比较实验验证EL与乙醇的性能差异，评估碳排放和抗氧化稳定性。
AI.findings: 1. ANN预测性能最佳（ANN > RSM > GPR），指导优化得到70°C、30分钟的最佳条件，鼠尾草酸提取率达2.90±0.05% w/w；2. EL与乙醇性能相当：鼠尾草酸纯度分别为18.4±0.11%和19.21±0.5%；3. 乙醇质量收率更高（15.25% vs 10.58%）；4. EL工艺碳排放显著降低至210 g CO₂/g提取物；5. EL提取物在菜籽油中保持抗氧化稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了乳酸乙酯作为绿色溶剂在天然产物提取中的有效性；2. 建立了数据驱动方法（特别是ANN）在绿色提取工艺优化中的优势；3. 为生物基溶剂在食品工业中的应用提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了具体的EL提取工艺参数（70°C、30分钟）；2. 证明了EL可替代乙醇用于天然抗氧化剂生产，减少碳排放；3. 为食品工业提供了环境友好的天然抗氧化剂提取方案；4. 展示了数据驱动方法在工艺优化中的实际应用价值。

title: Leakage-Safe IoT Intrusion Detection with White Shark Optimizer-Based Feature Selection
affiliations: Applied Science Private University (ASU), affiliation not provided to SSRN and Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia

detail.title: Leakage-Safe IoT Intrusion Detection with White Shark Optimizer-Based Feature Selection
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a leakage-safe evaluation framework for intrusion detection systems (IDS) tailored to Internet of Things (IoT) environments, coupled with a feature selection mechanism driven by the White Shark Optimizer (WSO). Conventional IDS evaluation methodologies frequently suffer from data leakage—arising from improper temporal mixing or cross-device information sharing—which yields unrealistically optimistic performance metrics. The proposed framework enforces rigorous temporal partitioning and device-specific isolation to eliminate leakage risks during model training and assessment. Feature subsets are optimized using the WSO, a bio-inspired metaheuristic that effectively balances global exploration and local exploitation through simulated shark hunting behaviors. Experiments conducted on benchmark IoT intrusion detection datasets such as CIC IoT DIAD 2024 reveal that the approach achieves higher detection accuracy, lower false positive rates, and stronger privacy guarantees compared to standard optimizers and leakage-vulnerable baselines. Ultimately, this method strengthens the trustworthiness and practical deployment potential of IoT security solutions while preserving evaluation integrity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对物联网环境的防泄漏入侵检测系统评估框架，结合了白鲨优化器驱动的特征选择机制，解决了传统评估中数据泄漏问题，提高了检测准确性和隐私保护。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个防泄漏的物联网入侵检测系统评估框架，并优化特征选择以提高检测性能？
AI.motivation: 传统IDS评估方法存在数据泄漏问题（时间混合不当或跨设备信息共享），导致性能指标过于乐观，无法反映真实部署效果，影响物联网安全解决方案的可信度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于防泄漏评估理论、生物启发式优化算法（白鲨优化器）、特征选择理论、物联网安全评估框架。
AI.method: 提出防泄漏评估框架，采用严格时间分区和设备特定隔离；使用白鲨优化器进行特征子集优化；在CIC IoT DIAD 2024等基准数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 该方法相比标准优化器和易泄漏基线，实现了更高的检测准确率、更低的误报率、更强的隐私保证，增强了物联网安全解决方案的可信度和实际部署潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了物联网环境下防泄漏IDS评估的理论框架；将生物启发式优化算法应用于特征选择；建立了严格的评估完整性保障机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可实际部署的防泄漏评估工具；提高了物联网入侵检测系统的真实性能评估；增强了安全解决方案的信任度和部署可行性。

title: Group Identity and Strategic Games in the Laboratory
affiliations: ESADE Business School and

detail.title: Group Identity and Strategic Games in the Laboratory
detail.abstract: Many economic decisions depend on others’ actions, making group identity an important driver of behavior. We show that group identity operates differently in games of strategic complements, where incentives align actions, versus strategic substitutes, where incentives push actions to diverge. In a laboratory experiment, participants are assigned to minimal groups (in-group, out-group, or no identity) and play one game type. Identity effects are short-lived in complements: in-group pairs begin more cooperatively, but behavior quickly converges and differences fade. In substitutes, out-group interactions are persistently less cooperative and yield lower payoffs. Mechanism evidence points to both preferences and learning: in substitutes, out-groups display more spiteful social preferences and are more often characterized by “Imitate the Successful” dynamics, whereas behavior in complements is well explained by belief-based learning. These results clarify when identity effects persist and why.​

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验室实验发现，群体认同在策略互补和策略替代两类博弈中的影响机制不同。在策略互补博弈中，群体认同效应短暂，组内合作初期更高但快速收敛；在策略替代博弈中，组外互动持续不合作且收益更低，机制涉及社会偏好和学习动态差异。
AI.research_question: 群体认同在不同策略结构（策略互补 vs. 策略替代）的博弈中如何影响行为动态和合作结果？
AI.motivation: 许多经济决策依赖于他人行动，群体认同是行为的重要驱动因素。然而，现有研究对群体认同在不同策略结构（互补与替代）中如何运作缺乏系统理解，需要澄清群体认同效应何时持续存在及其原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论中的策略互补和策略替代概念，结合群体认同理论、社会偏好理论和学习理论（如模仿成功者动态和信念学习）。
AI.method: 实验室实验方法，参与者被随机分配到最小群体（组内、组外或无身份），分别参与策略互补或策略替代博弈，观察行为动态和收益结果。
AI.findings: 1. 策略互补博弈中：组内配对初期合作性更高，但行为快速收敛，群体认同效应短暂；2. 策略替代博弈中：组外互动持续不合作且收益更低；3. 机制分析显示：策略替代中组外表现出更多恶意社会偏好，更常出现"模仿成功者"动态，而策略互补中的行为可用信念学习更好解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统区分群体认同在策略互补和策略替代博弈中的不同作用机制；2. 揭示了策略结构如何调节群体认同效应的持续性；3. 整合社会偏好和学习理论解释群体认同效应的动态变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织管理和团队设计提供启示：在互补性任务中群体认同可能只有短期效应，而在替代性任务中组外合作需要特别关注；2. 为政策制定者设计激励机制提供参考，考虑不同策略环境下的群体动态。

title: Digidhan Dashboard: A Digital Public Infrastructure for Monitoring, Analysis, and Promotion of India’s Digital Payment Ecosystem
affiliations: National Informatics Centre and National Informatics Centre

detail.title: Digidhan Dashboard: A Digital Public Infrastructure for Monitoring, Analysis, and Promotion of India’s Digital Payment Ecosystem
detail.abstract: India’s digital payment landscape has undergone an extraordinary transformation over the past decade, emerging as the world’s largest real-time payments ecosystem. From a baseline target of 2,500 crore transactions set by the Finance Minister for FY 2017–18, India’s Unified Payments Interface (UPI) alone processed 18,587 crore transactions worth Rs 261 lakh crore in FY 2024–25, and recorded 21.70 billion transactions in January 2026 — a compound annual growth rate exceeding 129% in volume. This paper presents the Digidhan Dashboard, developed by the National Informatics Centre (NIC) and commissioned by the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY), as the nation’s sole unified Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) platform for real-time monitoring, analysis, and governance of all digital payment modes across India. The paper describes the platform’s architecture, methodology, innovative features — including SFTP-based automated data ingestion, Business Intelligence analytics, Blockchain-based MDR reimbursement, AI-powered chatbot, and Smart City integration — and aligns the dashboard’s evolution with landmark government initiatives by MeitY and the Department of Financial Services (DFS). The paper further documents the latest fintech developments in India including UPI 3.0, the Unified Lending Interface (ULI), Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC – Digital Rupee), and UPI’s global expansion to 25 countries. Findings underscore the critical role of data-driven government platforms in accelerating financial inclusion and digital economic growth towards Viksit Bharat 2047.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了印度国家信息中心开发的Digidhan Dashboard，这是一个统一的数字公共基础设施平台，用于实时监控、分析和治理印度所有数字支付模式。论文描述了该平台的架构、创新功能，并记录了印度最新的金融科技发展，强调了数据驱动政府平台在加速金融包容性和数字经济增长方面的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 如何通过统一的数字公共基础设施平台（Digidhan Dashboard）有效监控、分析和治理印度的数字支付生态系统，以加速金融包容性和数字经济增长？
AI.motivation: 印度数字支付领域在过去十年经历了非凡转型，成为全球最大的实时支付生态系统。从2017-18财年财政部长设定的2500亿笔交易基准目标，到2024-25财年仅UPI就处理了18587亿笔交易，价值261万亿卢比，2026年1月记录了217亿笔交易，年复合增长率超过129%。需要统一的监控平台来管理这一快速增长的数字支付生态系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字公共基础设施（DPI）理论、实时支付生态系统治理、数据驱动的政府平台理论、金融包容性理论、数字经济增长理论
AI.method: 描述性研究方法，详细介绍了Digidhan Dashboard的平台架构、技术实现方法（包括SFTP自动化数据摄取、商业智能分析、基于区块链的MDR报销、AI聊天机器人、智慧城市集成等），并记录了平台与政府倡议的协同发展。
AI.findings: Digidhan Dashboard作为印度唯一的统一数字公共基础设施平台，成功实现了对所有数字支付模式的实时监控、分析和治理。平台的技术创新和功能设计有效支持了印度数字支付的快速增长，包括UPI 3.0、统一借贷接口、央行数字货币等最新金融科技发展，以及UPI在全球25个国家的扩张。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了数字公共基础设施平台在实时支付生态系统治理中的理论框架；2. 发展了数据驱动政府平台在金融包容性中的理论模型；3. 构建了数字支付监控平台与数字经济增长之间的理论联系；4. 为发展中国家数字支付治理提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印度政府提供了统一的数字支付监控和治理工具；2. 支持了UPI、数字卢比等金融科技创新的实施；3. 促进了金融包容性和数字经济增长；4. 为其他国家建立类似数字支付监控平台提供了实践参考；5. 支持了"Viksit Bharat 2047"国家发展愿景的实现。

title: How Does the Digital Economy Affect the Income Gap Between Urban and Rural Residents? — Evidence from China
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How Does the Digital Economy Affect the Income Gap Between Urban and Rural Residents? — Evidence from China

keywords: The Income Gap Between Urban and Rural Residents

detail.abstract: This study use the entropy approach to assess the degree of digital economy development based on panel data from 31 Chinese provincial regions from 2011 to 2023. The effect of the digital economy on the income gap between urban and rural residents is investigated using the Spatial Durbin Model. There are four different types of income gaps between urban and rural residents: wage, operational, property, and transfer.The many effects of the digital economy on different types of the income gap between urban and rural residents are examined. The findings demonstrate that the digital economy simultaneously exacerbates the the income gap between urban and rural residents in both the local and neighboring areas, with a greater detrimental effect on the neighboring areas. From the standpoint of various income categories, the digital economy decreases the operational and property income gaps between urban and rural residents in both local and neighboring areas, but it exacerbates the wage income gap between urban and rural residents in both local and neighboring areas.The effect of the digital economy on the transfer income gap between urban and rural residents has not yet emerged. The local and neighboring effects of the digital economy on the income gap between urban and rural residents exhibit notable variability from the viewpoints of various regions.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用熵值法评估中国31个省份2011-2023年数字经济发展水平，并采用空间杜宾模型分析数字经济对城乡居民收入差距的影响。研究发现数字经济总体上扩大了本地和邻近地区的城乡收入差距，但对不同收入类型（工资、经营、财产、转移）的影响存在差异。
AI.research_question: 数字经济如何影响中国城乡居民收入差距？具体而言，数字经济对不同类型收入（工资、经营、财产、转移）差距的影响有何差异？这种影响在空间上（本地与邻近地区）有何特征？
AI.motivation: 随着数字经济的快速发展，其对收入分配的影响日益受到关注。中国城乡收入差距问题长期存在，而数字经济可能通过不同渠道对各类收入产生差异化影响，需要系统研究其空间效应和机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间经济学理论，采用空间杜宾模型分析数字经济对收入差距的空间溢出效应。同时结合收入分类理论，将城乡收入差距细分为工资、经营、财产和转移四类收入差距。
AI.method: 1. 使用熵值法构建数字经济发展水平指标体系；2. 基于中国31个省份2011-2023年面板数据；3. 采用空间杜宾模型分析数字经济对城乡收入差距的影响；4. 将收入差距细分为四类进行分项分析。
AI.findings: 1. 数字经济总体上扩大了本地和邻近地区的城乡收入差距，对邻近地区的负面影响更大；2. 数字经济降低了本地和邻近地区的经营收入和财产收入差距；3. 数字经济扩大了本地和邻近地区的工资收入差距；4. 数字经济对转移收入差距的影响尚未显现；5. 数字经济对城乡收入差距的影响在不同地区存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了数字经济影响收入分配的空间分析框架；2. 揭示了数字经济对不同类型收入差距的差异化影响机制；3. 丰富了空间溢出效应在收入分配研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了数字经济影响城乡收入差距的实证依据；2. 建议针对不同类型收入差距采取差异化政策；3. 强调区域协调发展的必要性，减少数字经济的负面空间溢出效应。

title: LM-HTR: Learnable Masking Attention for Historical Text Recognition
affiliations: , Sharda University and

detail.title: LM-HTR: Learnable Masking Attention for Historical Text Recognition
detail.abstract: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) is critical for the digital preservation and subsequent retrieval of historical manuscripts. Despite this, the diverse range of handwriting styles, spacing, and degradation of documents due to factors like fading, ink bleed-through, and background noise remain issues with existing systems. While transformer-based recognizers provide strong global contextual modeling, dense self-attention may capture the noisy background rather than informative handwriting structures. We propose a transformer-based line-level HTR framework that integrates spatially selective attention mechanisms to improve robustness in a training-from-scratch setting without synthetic data augmentation or external language models. The framework enhances discriminative feature learning through deformable attention, which sparsely samples content-adaptive spatial locations, and learnable masking attention, which emphasizes informative handwriting regions while suppressing background interference. Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) loss is used to train the model end-to-end. Experiments on the READ2016, LAM, and IAM benchmarks demonstrate improvements over existing transformer-based HTR approaches, particularly on degraded manuscripts. The results indicate that spatially selective attention provides an effective design strategy for improving robustness and accuracy in archival handwritten text recognition. The code and dataset used in this work are available at https://github.com/…

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的手写文本识别框架，通过集成空间选择性注意力机制（可变形注意力和可学习掩码注意力）来提高对退化历史手稿的识别鲁棒性，无需合成数据增强或外部语言模型。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个基于Transformer的手写文本识别框架，使其在训练从头开始时能够更好地处理历史手稿中多样的笔迹风格、间距和退化问题，同时避免密集自注意力对噪声背景的过度关注？
AI.motivation: 历史手稿的数字化保存和检索需要准确的手写文本识别，但现有系统面临笔迹风格多样、间距不规则以及褪色、墨水渗透、背景噪声等退化问题的挑战。虽然基于Transformer的识别器提供了强大的全局上下文建模能力，但密集自注意力可能更多地关注噪声背景而非信息丰富的笔迹结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Transformer的序列识别框架，结合空间选择性注意力机制（包括可变形注意力和可学习掩码注意力），以及连接时序分类（CTC）损失函数。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于Transformer的行级手写文本识别框架，使用可变形注意力稀疏采样内容自适应的空间位置，以及可学习掩码注意力强调信息丰富的笔迹区域并抑制背景干扰。模型使用CTC损失进行端到端训练，无需合成数据增强或外部语言模型。
AI.findings: 在READ2016、LAM和IAM基准测试上的实验表明，该方法优于现有的基于Transformer的手写文本识别方法，特别是在退化手稿上表现更佳。结果表明空间选择性注意力为提高档案手写文本识别的鲁棒性和准确性提供了有效的设计策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了空间选择性注意力机制作为提高手写文本识别鲁棒性的设计策略；2. 展示了可变形注意力和可学习掩码注意力在抑制背景噪声、强调笔迹结构方面的有效性；3. 证明了在训练从头开始设置下无需数据增强或语言模型即可实现高性能。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个开源的手写文本识别框架，可用于历史档案的数字化处理；2. 在多个基准数据集上展示了优越性能，特别是在退化手稿上；3. 代码和数据集已公开，便于研究和应用。

title: A Two-Stage Framework for Diffusion Source Localization via Sensor-Guided Network Pruning and Temporal-Topological Alignment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Northwestern Polytechnic University (NPU)

detail.title: A Two-Stage Framework for Diffusion Source Localization via Sensor-Guided Network Pruning and Temporal-Topological Alignment
detail.abstract: Diffusion Source Localization (DSL) is essential for information security and network forensics, enabling the identification of origins for malicious cascades such as rumors, misinformation, and malware outbreaks. Existing methods face significant practical limitations due to their dependence on detailed diffusion information, including explicit transmission pathways or predefined propagation parameters. We propose Temporal-topological Region-constrained Approach for diffusion sourCe Estimation (TRACE), a lightweight DSL framework that operates effectively under sparse observation conditions by requiring only infection timestamps from a limited set of sensor nodes. TRACE employs a two-stage methodology to address both data scarcity and computational scalability. In the first stage, a Bounded Attempt Strategy (BAS) grounded in percolation theory optimizes sensor placement at structurally critical locations, enabling a simple topological partitioning procedure to isolate a compact candidate region containing the diffusion source. This stage significantly reduces the search space from O(n) to O(c) with c « n. In the second stage, a non-parametric cosine-similarity-based estimator identifies the source within this reduced region by measuring the alignment between observed temporal patterns and topology-induced spatial distances. Comprehensive experiments on twelve real-world networks spanning social, communication, transportation, and infrastructure domains demonstrate that TRACE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in localization accuracy, spatial precision, and computational efficiency. Further analyses confirm the robustness of TRACE under high-variance diffusion conditions and its scalability to large-scale networks.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个轻量级扩散源定位框架，仅需有限传感器节点的感染时间戳，通过两阶段方法在稀疏观测条件下有效定位恶意信息传播源头。
AI.research_question: 如何在仅拥有有限传感器节点感染时间戳的稀疏观测条件下，准确且高效地定位网络中的扩散源头？
AI.motivation: 现有扩散源定位方法依赖详细的传播信息（如明确传播路径或预定义传播参数），在实际应用中存在显著局限性，需要能在稀疏观测条件下工作的轻量级解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 渗透理论（用于传感器放置优化）、拓扑分区理论、非参数余弦相似度估计（用于时间模式与空间距离对齐）
AI.method: 两阶段方法：1）基于渗透理论的边界尝试策略优化传感器放置，通过拓扑分区隔离紧凑候选区域；2）基于余弦相似度的非参数估计器在候选区域内识别源头
AI.findings: 在12个真实网络（社交、通信、交通、基础设施）上的实验表明，TRACE在定位精度、空间精度和计算效率方面均优于现有方法，且在高方差扩散条件下具有鲁棒性，可扩展到大规模网络
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出基于渗透理论的传感器放置优化框架；2）开发了将时间模式与拓扑诱导空间距离对齐的非参数估计方法；3）建立了从O(n)到O(c)的搜索空间缩减理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供仅需感染时间戳的轻量级扩散源定位解决方案；2）显著降低计算复杂度，适用于大规模网络；3）在多种真实网络场景中展示优越性能，可用于谣言、错误信息和恶意软件爆发的源头追踪

title: Does AI Literacy Drive Usage? Evidence from a Large-Scale Study on Early GenAI Adoption in Higher Education
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Sri Eshwar College of Engineering

detail.title: Does AI Literacy Drive Usage? Evidence from a Large-Scale Study on Early GenAI Adoption in Higher Education
detail.abstract: The rapid development of tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek opportunities, and their integration into advanced education, is reshaping how students learn, think, and engage with information. While their usage is becoming more widespread, there is limited empirical research focusing on how first-year students perceive, intend to use, and subsequently adopt these tools, particularly during their initial interactions with the university. This research aims to explore the primary predictors of the adoption and use of GenAI tools by first-year students in Malaysia, based on a Hybrid UTAUT–AI Literacy Model, which integrates UTAUT with AI literacy and academic integrity.  Research data for this cross-sectional explanatory study were collected via a quantitative survey during the orientation week from 1,939 first-year students, which were subsequently analysed using PLS-SEM.  Among the predictors of behavioural intention, hedonic motivation, trust, performance expectancy, and social influence stood out, while AI literacy was a predictor of early adoption.  Facilitating conditions, expected effort, and concerns of academic integrity were described as effort to integrate AI more than expected. Concerns regarding academic integrity, the expected effort, and the existence of enabling conditions were considered inconsequential. Findings suggest that the influence of AI literacy shapes the relationship between the behavioural intention and the initial usage, while past experience with GenAI further strengthens this relationship, as shown in a multi-group analysis. This research deepens theoretical knowledge by broadening the UTAUT framework, as well as adds empirical evidence regarding the first phases of GenAI adoption in the higher education context. This article should be of interest to policymakers and educators who aim to design effective onboarding and digital readiness strategies for new students.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于混合UTAUT-AI素养模型，探讨马来西亚大一学生采用生成式AI工具的主要预测因素。研究发现享乐动机、信任、绩效期望和社会影响是行为意图的关键预测因素，而AI素养预测早期采用。AI素养调节行为意图与初始使用之间的关系。
AI.research_question: 马来西亚大一学生采用生成式AI工具的主要预测因素是什么？基于混合UTAUT-AI素养模型，哪些因素影响学生的采用意图和早期使用行为？
AI.motivation: ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek等生成式AI工具在高等教育中的整合正在重塑学生学习方式，但缺乏关于大一学生对这些工具的感知、使用意图和采用行为的实证研究，特别是在大学初始阶段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合UTAUT-AI素养模型，整合了统一技术接受与使用理论（UTAUT）、AI素养和学术诚信三个维度。
AI.method: 横断面解释性研究，在迎新周期间通过定量调查收集1,939名大一学生数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行分析。
AI.findings: 行为意图的主要预测因素包括享乐动机、信任、绩效期望和社会影响；AI素养是早期采用的预测因素；促进条件、期望努力和学术诚信担忧对整合AI的影响超过预期；AI素养调节行为意图与初始使用之间的关系；过去的GenAI经验加强这种关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过整合AI素养和学术诚信维度扩展了UTAUT框架，为高等教育背景下GenAI采用初期阶段提供了实证证据，深化了对技术接受理论的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和教育工作者设计有效的新生入职培训和数字准备策略提供参考，帮助理解影响学生采用AI工具的关键因素，特别是AI素养在早期采用中的重要作用。

title: Correlation Architecture Fingerprinting for Network Intrusion Characterization: A Weighted Jaccard Approach Validated Across Two Independent Datasets

detail.title: Correlation Architecture Fingerprinting for Network Intrusion Characterization: A Weighted Jaccard Approach Validated Across Two Independent Datasets
detail.abstract: Network intrusion detection systems (IDS) identify malicious traffic but provide limited characterization of the structural impact an attack has on the network's operational profile. This study introduces Weighted Jaccard (WJ) correlation architecture monitoring as a method for characterizing network intrusion through the reorganization of pairwise correlations among network flow features. The method computes full pairwise Spearman correlation matrices among all traffic features under normal and attack conditions, then quantifies architectural similarity using the Jaccard similarity index. Validation on two independent datasets -- UNSW-NB15 (31 features, 465 pairs, 9 attack types, 257,673 records) and CSE-CIC-IDS2018 (68 features, 2,278 pairs, 6 attack types, 994,796 records) -- demonstrates that all 15 tested attack types produce statistically significant correlation architecture reorganization (15/15 FDR-corrected, all p < 0.001). The magnitude of reorganization maps to the behavioral footprint of the attack: broad-spectrum attacks (DoS, Generic, Bot) produce the greatest reorganization (WJ = 0.51-0.65), targeted attacks (Brute Force, Shellcode, Fuzzers) produce moderate reorganization (WJ = 0.71-0.73), and stealthy attacks (Infiltration) produce the least (WJ = 0.87). This behavioral taxonomy replicates across both datasets and is robust across four edge thresholds (|r| > 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5). WJ correlation architecture fingerprinting provides a forensic characterization capability that complements conventional detection-focused IDS.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出加权Jaccard相关架构监控方法，通过分析网络流量特征间的相关性重组来表征网络入侵的结构性影响，验证了15种攻击类型均会导致显著的相关性架构重组，且重组程度与攻击行为特征相关。
AI.research_question: 如何量化网络入侵对网络流量特征相关性架构的结构性影响？
AI.motivation: 传统入侵检测系统主要识别恶意流量，但缺乏对攻击如何改变网络运营配置文件结构影响的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于相关性分析和Jaccard相似性指数的网络架构监控理论，将网络流量特征间的相关性视为网络运营的结构性表征。
AI.method: 计算正常和攻击条件下所有流量特征间的Spearman相关矩阵，使用加权Jaccard相似性指数量化架构相似性，在两个独立数据集（UNSW-NB15和CSE-CIC-IDS2018）上验证。
AI.findings: 所有15种攻击类型均产生统计显著的相关性架构重组；重组程度与攻击行为特征相关：广谱攻击（DoS、Generic、Bot）重组最大（WJ=0.51-0.65），针对性攻击（Brute Force、Shellcode、Fuzzers）中等（WJ=0.71-0.73），隐蔽攻击（Infiltration）最小（WJ=0.87）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了网络入侵的结构性影响量化框架，建立了相关性架构重组与攻击行为特征之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种法医特征分析能力，可补充传统入侵检测系统，帮助理解攻击对网络运营的结构性影响。

title: Personal Data Protection in the Age of AI: A Comparative Study of Legal Frameworks in Saudi Arabia and the European Union
affiliations: Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University, Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University and Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University

detail.title: Personal Data Protection in the Age of AI: A Comparative Study of Legal Frameworks in Saudi Arabia and the European Union
detail.abstract: The rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) has increased global reliance on automated data analysis and decision-making, raising significant legal challenges around personal data protection. AI systems require vast datasets, intensifying concerns over privacy, data security, and individual rights. In response, Saudi Arabia enacted the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) to safeguard personal information amid accelerating technological advancements. This paper presents a comparative analysis of Saudi Arabia’s data protection framework against the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). It examines key legal provisions, regulatory mechanisms, and enforcement strategies to assess the effectiveness of PDPL in managing AI-driven data processing. The roles of national authorities such as the Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA) and the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) are explored in balancing innovation with rights protection. The study concludes with recommendations to strengthen the framework through le- gal updates, awareness initiatives, and international cooperation aligned with global standards.

AI.tldr: 本文对沙特阿拉伯《个人数据保护法》(PDPL)与欧盟《通用数据保护条例》(GDPR)进行比较分析，评估PDPL在管理AI驱动数据处理方面的有效性，并提出加强框架的建议。
AI.research_question: 沙特阿拉伯的个人数据保护法律框架（PDPL）在管理人工智能驱动的数据处理方面，与欧盟的GDPR相比，其有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 人工智能的快速采用增加了全球对自动化数据分析和决策的依赖，引发了个人数据保护方面的重大法律挑战。AI系统需要大量数据集，加剧了人们对隐私、数据安全和个体权利的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法律分析框架，重点关注数据保护法律原则、监管机制和执法策略。涉及个人数据保护权、隐私权、数据安全等法律理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对沙特阿拉伯PDPL与欧盟GDPR进行对比分析，考察关键法律条款、监管机制和执法策略。
AI.findings: 通过比较分析评估PDPL在管理AI驱动数据处理方面的有效性，探讨沙特数据与人工智能局(SDAIA)和国家网络安全局(NCA)在平衡创新与权利保护方面的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为人工智能时代的数据保护法律比较研究提供理论框架，特别是在伊斯兰法律传统与欧洲法律传统的交叉点上，丰富了全球数据保护法律体系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出通过法律更新、意识提升倡议和国际合作来加强沙特数据保护框架的具体建议，为政策制定者、监管机构和企业在AI时代的数据保护实践提供指导。

title: Life-Aware Coordinated Peak-Shaving and Frequency Regulation Optimization for CAES-Integrated Power Systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering, Stanford University, King Saud University and University of Bath

detail.title: Life-Aware Coordinated Peak-Shaving and Frequency Regulation Optimization for CAES-Integrated Power Systems
detail.abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources (RESs), compressed air energy storage (CAES) offers a promising solution for coordinating peak shaving and fast frequency support. However, most existing studies do not explicitly consider CAES frequency-response dynamics and cavern lifetime degradation in system-level scheduling. This paper proposes a life-aware, chance-constrained optimization framework for CAES-integrated power systems. A multi-mode system frequency response (SFR) model is established to characterize post-disturbance frequency dynamics under different CAES operating modes, while a mechanistic cyclic-life model based on the Chaboche fatigue theory is used to quantify long-term cavern degradation. To handle the strong nonlinear coupling between frequency-security constraints and life-consumption cost, a Newton-assisted deep neural network (DNN) linearization method is developed to enable tractable mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) reformulation. Case studies show that the proposed framework reduces the total operating cost by 6.4%, decreases CAES lifetime degradation by 75.6%, and improves renewable utilization from 68.9% to 73.1%. The results indicate that CAES can effectively support the coordinated improvement of economic operation, frequency security, and lifetime management in power systems with high renewable penetration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑压缩空气储能（CAES）频率响应动态和储气库寿命退化的机会约束优化框架，通过牛顿辅助深度神经网络线性化方法，实现了经济性、频率安全和寿命管理的协同优化。
AI.research_question: 如何在高可再生能源渗透的电力系统中，协调考虑CAES的频率响应动态和储气库寿命退化，实现经济调度、频率安全和寿命管理的协同优化？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多未明确考虑CAES的频率响应动态和储气库寿命退化问题，而随着可再生能源渗透率提高，CAES在调峰和快速频率支撑方面具有重要作用，需要综合考虑这些因素的系统级调度方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 基于Chaboche疲劳理论的机理循环寿命模型，用于量化长期储气库退化；2. 多模式系统频率响应（SFR）模型，用于表征不同CAES运行模式下的扰动后频率动态；3. 机会约束优化理论。
AI.method: 提出了一种生命感知的机会约束优化框架，开发了牛顿辅助深度神经网络（DNN）线性化方法，将强非线性耦合的频率安全约束和寿命消耗成本转化为可处理的混合整数线性规划（MILP）问题。
AI.findings: 案例研究表明，所提框架将总运行成本降低6.4%，CAES寿命退化减少75.6%，可再生能源利用率从68.9%提高到73.1%。CAES能有效支持经济运行、频率安全和寿命管理的协同改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了综合考虑CAES频率响应动态和储气库寿命退化的系统级调度理论框架；2. 提出了牛顿辅助DNN线性化方法，解决了频率安全约束与寿命消耗成本之间的强非线性耦合问题；3. 发展了多模式SFR模型与机理循环寿命模型的集成方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为高可再生能源渗透电力系统提供了实用的CAES调度优化工具；2. 显著降低了系统运行成本和CAES设备寿命退化；3. 提高了可再生能源利用率，增强了系统频率安全性；4. 为储能系统的全生命周期管理提供了技术支撑。

title: Local Individualistic Culture and Financial Adviser Misconduct
affiliations: Macquarie University - Faculty of Business and Economics, Macquarie University and Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University (XJTLU)

detail.title: Local Individualistic Culture and Financial Adviser Misconduct
detail.abstract: In this study, we show that financial advisers who are located in counties with a higher level of individualistic culture are less likely to commit professional misconduct. The effect of local individualistic culture on adviser misconduct is stronger for male advisers, experienced advisers, advisers with a prior misconduct record, and is more pronounced during the financial crisis. We further provide evidence that reputational costs are the underlying mechanism through which individualistic culture affects adviser misconduct. In the extended analysis, we find that advisers who committed misconduct tend to move to counties with a relatively lower level of individualism than that of their previous employment location. Collectively, our results highlight the importance of the local cultural environment to financial market ethics.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，位于个人主义文化水平较高地区的金融顾问更少发生职业不当行为，这种影响对男性、经验丰富、有不当行为记录的顾问以及在金融危机期间更为明显。声誉成本是主要作用机制，且有过不当行为的顾问倾向于迁移到个人主义水平较低的地区。
AI.research_question: 地方个人主义文化如何影响金融顾问的职业不当行为？
AI.motivation: 理解文化环境对金融市场道德行为的影响，特别是个人主义文化如何塑造金融专业人士的职业操守。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化经济学、社会规范理论、声誉机制理论
AI.method: 实证分析，使用金融顾问不当行为数据与地区个人主义文化指标进行回归分析，考察调节效应和机制检验
AI.findings: 1) 高个人主义文化地区顾问不当行为更少；2) 对男性、经验丰富、有不当行为记录顾问影响更强；3) 金融危机期间效应更明显；4) 声誉成本是作用机制；5) 有过不当行为顾问倾向于迁移到低个人主义地区
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将文化因素纳入金融道德行为分析框架；2) 揭示个人主义文化通过声誉机制影响职业行为；3) 拓展了文化经济学在金融领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为金融机构选址和人才管理提供文化视角；2) 为监管机构考虑地区文化差异制定差异化政策；3) 帮助投资者理解顾问行为的地域差异

title: Research on Data Standards for Combat Tactics and Methods
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Research on Data Standards for Combat Tactics and Methods
detail.abstract: To address challenges in realistic combat training, including insufficient data support for tactics, inability to share training data, and poor coordination in joint operations, and to meet the requirements of the winning mechanism of informatized warfare, this research systematically reviews the fundamental concepts and evolution of tactics and data standards. It clarifies the definition, classification system, and core components of military combat tactics. Based on regulations such as the PLA Military Terminology and the Outline for Joint Operations, a three-tier tactical data architecture encompassing "Basic Tactics Data – Core Operational Elements Data – Support and Coordination Data" was constructed. A data standard for military combat tactics is proposed, comprising 11 data categories, 17 data subcategories, and 100 data items. Utilizing a prototype tactics database system and employing data consistency and completeness verification methods, the "Joint Operations Cyber Attack UAV Tactics" served as a case study. Results indicate that this data standard effectively covers core tactical information, ensuring data consistency, accuracy, and interoperability. The findings not only enrich the military operational theory system but also provide a unified data benchmark for tactics database development, establishing a foundation for weapon system synergy, compatibility of campaign and tactical actions, and cross-domain data sharing.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对实战化训练中的数据不足、数据共享困难和联合作战协调不畅等问题，构建了包含"基础战术数据-核心作战要素数据-保障协调数据"的三层战术数据架构，提出了包含11个数据类别、17个子类别和100个数据项的军事作战战术数据标准，并通过原型系统验证了其有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统化的军事作战战术数据标准，以解决实战化训练中的数据支持不足、数据共享困难和联合作战协调不畅等问题？
AI.motivation: 现实作战训练面临三大挑战：1）战术数据支持不足；2）训练数据无法共享；3）联合作战协调性差。同时需要满足信息化战争制胜机制的要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）战术基础概念与演进理论；2）军事作战战术的定义、分类体系和核心要素理论；3）基于《中国人民解放军军语》和《联合作战纲要》等法规的战术数据架构理论。
AI.method: 1）系统回顾战术与数据标准的基础概念与演进；2）构建三层战术数据架构；3）提出包含11类、17子类、100项的数据标准；4）通过原型战术数据库系统，采用数据一致性和完整性验证方法，以"联合作战网络攻击无人机战术"为案例进行验证。
AI.findings: 该数据标准能有效覆盖核心战术信息，确保数据的一致性、准确性和互操作性。案例研究表明标准具有实用性和有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）丰富了军事作战理论体系；2）建立了系统化的战术数据分类和架构理论；3）为战术数据标准化提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为战术数据库开发提供了统一的数据基准；2）为武器系统协同、战役战术行动兼容奠定了基础；3）支持跨领域数据共享；4）提升了联合作战训练效果。

title: A Parallel C&CG-ADMM Algorithm for Integrated Energy Systems with Data Centers under Offshore Wind Uncertainty via Wasserstein-Based Scenario Reduction
affiliations: South China University of Technology, South China University of Technology, South China University of Technology, South China University of Technology and South China University of Technology

detail.title: A Parallel C&CG-ADMM Algorithm for Integrated Energy Systems with Data Centers under Offshore Wind Uncertainty via Wasserstein-Based Scenario Reduction
detail.abstract: Integrated electricity and natural gas systems (IEGS) are increasingly challenged by renewable energy uncertainty and privacy-preserving coordination among multiple operators. Two-stage distributionally robust optimization (TSDRO) has been widely adopted to address such uncertainty. However, solving TSDRO models introduces challenges: centralized algorithms require full information sharing, raising privacy concerns, while existing distributed approaches often suffer from convergence difficulties and low computational efficiency in mixed-integer problems. To address these issues, this paper develops a distributed solution framework for TSDRO in IEGS and further proposes a parallel C&CG-ADMM algorithm as its core component. In this framework, the day-ahead stage centrally solves the power system master problem, while the intraday stage employs the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) to enable distributed coordination between subsystems. A scenario-parallel strategy further accelerates subproblem computation, improving efficiency while maintaining convergence. To enhance uncertainty modeling and system flexibility, offshore wind power uncertainty is characterized using a two-dimensional Wasserstein-distance-based K-medoids (2D-WKMd) clustering method, and a probability ambiguity set with joint 1-norm and ∞-norm constraints is constructed. The spatiotemporal transferability of data center workloads is incorporated to extract demand-side flexibility, and carbon emission costs are included to promote low-carbon operation. Case studies based on offshore wind data from Fujian, China, demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves high solution accuracy and computational efficiency, while effectively mitigating unit output fluctuations and enhancing overall system economic performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对综合电力天然气系统(IEGS)中可再生能源不确定性和多运营商隐私保护协调的挑战，提出了一个分布式两阶段分布鲁棒优化(TSDRO)框架，并开发了并行C&CG-ADMM算法作为核心组件。该框架采用日前阶段集中求解主问题、日内阶段ADMM分布式协调的方式，结合场景并行策略加速计算。通过2D-WKMd聚类方法表征海上风电不确定性，构建概率模糊集，并利用数据中心负载时空可转移性和碳排放成本提升系统灵活性。
AI.research_question: 如何在保护隐私的前提下，高效解决综合电力天然气系统中的两阶段分布鲁棒优化问题，同时处理可再生能源不确定性和多运营商协调挑战？
AI.motivation: 综合电力天然气系统面临可再生能源不确定性和多运营商隐私保护协调的双重挑战。现有方法存在局限性：集中式算法需要完全信息共享，引发隐私担忧；而分布式方法在混合整数问题上收敛困难且计算效率低。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 两阶段分布鲁棒优化理论；2) 交替方向乘子法(ADMM)分布式协调理论；3) 基于Wasserstein距离的K-medoids聚类方法；4) 概率模糊集理论(1-范数和∞-范数约束)；5) 列与约束生成(C&CG)算法。
AI.method: 1) 提出分布式TSDRO框架：日前阶段集中求解电力系统主问题，日内阶段采用ADMM进行子系统分布式协调；2) 开发并行C&CG-ADMM算法作为核心；3) 使用2D-WKMd聚类方法表征海上风电不确定性；4) 构建联合1-范数和∞-范数约束的概率模糊集；5) 引入数据中心负载时空可转移性和碳排放成本。
AI.findings: 基于福建海上风电数据的案例研究表明：1) 所提框架实现了高求解精度和计算效率；2) 有效缓解了机组出力波动；3) 提升了整体系统经济性能；4) 场景并行策略显著加速了子问题计算。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了适用于IEGS的分布式TSDRO理论框架；2) 发展了并行C&CG-ADMM算法，解决了混合整数问题的收敛和效率问题；3) 改进了不确定性建模方法(2D-WKMd聚类和概率模糊集)；4) 将需求侧灵活性(数据中心负载)和低碳目标纳入优化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为多运营商IEGS提供了隐私保护的分布式协调方案；2) 提高了系统应对可再生能源不确定性的能力；3) 通过并行计算提升了实际工程应用的计算效率；4) 为低碳电力系统运行提供了可操作的优化框架。

title: Beyond Subsidies: A State-Enabled Framework for Cooperative Entrepreneurship in Emerging Economies
affiliations: Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) - Faculty of Economics and Business (FEB)

detail.title: Beyond Subsidies: A State-Enabled Framework for Cooperative Entrepreneurship in Emerging Economies
detail.abstract: Indonesian cooperatives remain economically marginal despite constitutional mandates, often trapped in state dependency. The "Koperasi Merah Putih" initiative signals renewed political will to revitalize the sector, yet risks replicating historical failures if relying on welfare-based models rather than entrepreneurial dynamics. This conceptual article introduces the State-Enabled Cooperative Entrepreneurship Model (SECEM), synthesizing cooperative entrepreneurship theory with emerging economy institutional realities. SECEM posits that sustainable performance emerges from synergistic interplay between high-quality state intervention (capability-building), collective entrepreneurial orientation, and critical human capital moderators, specifically financial literacy and digital integration. Grounded in Gotong Royong (mutual cooperation), the framework challenges Western-centric assumptions by modelling the state as active architect rather than passive regulator. We contribute by: (1) contextualizing cooperative entrepreneurship theory to institutional voids; (2) elaborating Institutional Theory through "Quality of State Intervention" as dual-edged mechanism; and (3) integrating human capital and digital dimensions as critical moderators. Successful revitalization requires three transformations: shifting from direct aid to ecosystem development, professionalizing governance without eroding social capital, and leveraging digital tools for market scale. Theoretical and practical implications for emerging economies are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"国家赋能合作社创业模型"(SECEM)，认为印度尼西亚合作社的可持续发展需要高质量国家干预、集体创业导向以及金融素养和数字整合等人力资本调节因素的协同作用，而非传统的福利依赖模式。
AI.research_question: 在制度真空的新兴经济体中，如何通过国家赋能合作社创业模型(SECEM)实现合作社的可持续振兴，避免历史性失败的重演？
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚合作社虽受宪法保障，但在经济上仍处于边缘地位，往往陷入国家依赖的困境。"红白合作社"倡议显示出振兴该领域的政治意愿，但如果继续依赖福利模式而非创业动力，可能重蹈历史覆辙。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 合作社创业理论；2) 制度理论（特别是"国家干预质量"作为双重机制）；3) 人力资本理论；4) 基于Gotong Royong（互助合作）的本土化框架，挑战西方中心主义假设。
AI.method: 概念性文章，通过理论综合构建国家赋能合作社创业模型(SECEM)，整合合作社创业理论与新兴经济体制度现实。
AI.findings: 可持续绩效源于高质量国家干预（能力建设）、集体创业导向以及金融素养和数字整合等关键人力资本调节因素的协同作用。成功的振兴需要三个转变：从直接援助转向生态系统发展、专业化治理而不侵蚀社会资本、利用数字工具扩大市场规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将合作社创业理论情境化到制度真空环境；2) 通过"国家干预质量"作为双重机制来阐述制度理论；3) 将人力资本和数字维度整合为关键调节因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体合作社振兴提供实践框架：国家应从被动监管者转变为积极架构师，推动从福利模式向创业模式的转变，同时平衡专业化治理与社会资本保护，利用数字技术扩大市场覆盖。

title: Breaking Up: Fragmentation in Foreign Direct Investment
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Breaking Up: Fragmentation in Foreign Direct Investment
detail.abstract: Rising geopolitical tensions and supply chain vulnerabilities have driven recent fragmentation of foreign direct investment (FDI). This paper provides systematic evidence of FDI fragmentation along ideological and geographic lines across multiple types of FDI. On the intensive margin, the capital expenditures of multinationals’ subsidiaries have shifted away from geopolitically risky countries (“derisking”) and toward geographically proximate countries, with additional evidence of reshoring. On the extensive margin, greenfield FDI primarily shows derisking, while cross-border M&A exhibits broader ideological fragmentation. At the industry level, derisking is pervasive across industries, while other forms of fragmentation are concentrated in a narrower set of sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了外国直接投资（FDI）在地缘政治紧张和供应链脆弱性背景下的碎片化现象，发现FDI沿着意识形态和地理界线出现系统性分裂，表现为去风险化、地理邻近化以及产业层面的差异化模式。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治紧张和供应链脆弱性如何导致外国直接投资（FDI）沿着意识形态和地理界线出现系统性碎片化？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治紧张局势加剧和供应链脆弱性上升促使跨国公司重新评估其全球投资策略，导致FDI模式发生系统性变化，需要实证证据来理解这种碎片化的具体表现和机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险理论、供应链管理理论、跨国公司投资决策理论、FDI碎片化理论
AI.method: 系统实证分析，包括集约边际（现有子公司资本支出变化）和扩展边际（绿地投资与跨境并购）的多维度考察，以及产业层面的差异化分析
AI.findings:
1. 集约边际：跨国公司子公司资本支出从地缘政治高风险国家转移（去风险化），转向地理邻近国家，并有回流母国证据
2. 扩展边际：绿地投资主要表现出去风险化特征，而跨境并购显示出更广泛的意识形态碎片化
3. 产业层面：去风险化在各行业普遍存在，其他形式的碎片化集中在较窄的行业范围内
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次系统性地实证验证了FDI沿着意识形态和地理界线的碎片化现象
2. 区分了集约边际和扩展边际的不同碎片化模式
3. 揭示了不同类型FDI（绿地投资vs跨境并购）对地缘政治风险的不同反应机制
4. 提供了产业层面碎片化异质性的理论解释
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为跨国公司制定地缘政治风险下的投资策略提供实证依据
2. 为政策制定者理解FDI流动变化趋势提供参考
3. 帮助企业识别供应链脆弱性和投资风险
4. 为投资者评估跨国公司的地缘政治风险暴露提供分析框架

title: Combining quadratic programming and reinforcement learning for real-world vehicle-to-grid charge control
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Combining quadratic programming and reinforcement learning for real-world vehicle-to-grid charge control
detail.abstract: Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) enables electric vehicles to provide flexibility to the power system through bidirectional charging, but practical control of vehicle fleets remains challenging due to heterogeneous vehicle fleets, power capacity constraints and the need to regard battery degradation. This paper proposes a fleet-level charging and discharging strategy that combines Reinforcement Learning (RL) for strategic decision-making with Quadratic Programming (QP) for real-time power allocation under physical power capacity constraints. The RL agent determines high-level charging objectives, while the QP controller ensures feasible and coordinated power distribution among vehicles. Deep Q-Networks (DQN) are used as the RL method, and it is shown that training convergence is improved by employing n-step learning. A compact feature representation combined with radial basis functions enables training times on the order of one minute on a standard PC, making the approach suitable for practical use.The proposed framework supports parallel participation in energy and balancing markets without relying on explicit future information. The approach is evaluated through a simulation study based on a heavy-duty vehicle fleet use case and real electricity price data. The results demonstrate stable training behavior and economically viable operation under realistic conditions. In addition to real-world control, the simulation study shows that the RL–QP framework is also useful for techno-economic evaluation of V2G systems.
