AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合强化学习（RL）和二次规划（QP）的V2G车队充放电控制框架。RL负责高层策略决策，QP处理实时功率分配，解决了异质车队、功率容量约束和电池退化等挑战。该方法无需依赖未来信息，支持同时参与能源和平衡市场，仿真验证了其经济可行性和实用性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个实用的V2G车队充放电控制策略，能够有效处理异质车辆、功率容量约束和电池退化问题，同时支持市场参与且不依赖未来信息？
AI.motivation: V2G技术使电动汽车能够为电网提供灵活性，但实际控制面临异质车队、功率容量约束和电池退化等挑战，需要开发实用且高效的控制策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合强化学习（战略决策）和二次规划（实时功率分配）的混合控制框架，采用深度Q网络（DQN）和n步学习改进训练收敛性。
AI.method: 使用紧凑特征表示和径向基函数，在标准PC上实现分钟级训练；通过仿真研究基于重型车辆车队用例和真实电价数据进行评估。
AI.findings: 方法表现出稳定的训练行为，在现实条件下实现经济可行的运行；RL-QP框架不仅适用于实际控制，也可用于V2G系统的技术经济评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合RL和QP的混合控制框架理论，展示了n步学习如何改善训练收敛性，开发了紧凑特征表示方法以加速训练。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实用的V2G车队控制解决方案，支持并行参与能源和平衡市场，无需依赖未来信息；框架可用于实际系统部署和技术经济分析。

title: Structural integrity for bulk hazardous chemical shipments
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Structural integrity for bulk hazardous chemical shipments
detail.abstract: Packaging and transportation of hazardous chemical materials require a certain number of tests to be done. An intermediate Bulk Containers are widely used for packaging and shipping bulk materials. For dry refined hazardous materials are packaged inside Flexible Intermediate containers or FIBC super-sacks, which are widely used in the chemical industry for bulk handling of powders, granules, and specialty materials. These materials require packaging solutions that ensure containment, integrity, electrostatic safety, and compliance with DOT hazardous material regulations. This paper explores advancements in FIBC super-sack designs and specifications that include different fabric thickness, different liner materials, and UN- certified configuration that will be used for sensitive chemical compounds. A comparative analysis of two different specifications will help us to determine the possible cost savings.,The proposal of the project is to develop the best packaging solution for packaging hazardous chemicals. This paper examines the regulatory requirements and technical standards for UN-rated Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers (FIBCs), commonly known as super sacks, used to transport hazardous chemicals in Packing Groups II and III. It provides an overview of classification systems, performance criteria, and compliance obligations under international and U.S. regulations.,For shipping hazardous materials, UN testing is required to check if the packaging can hold the type of hazardous material. After careful testing of the material to be shipped we found out the DOT requirement for these materials. If the test says hazardous material, then the material is classified as class 9 which will require UN certification for shipping hazardous chemicals. This proposal highlights the use of two different specifications of FIBC super-sacks. The two FIBC super-sacks specifications were selected for their robust working loads. There are two different thick body fabrics used for testing. The difference in cost was also the motive for selecting a lower and a higher GSM bag. By doing a PG3 UN test on both specifications, we can determine if the lower specification bag passes then in turn, it will be cheaper than the higher specification bags for packaging the rare earth hazardous substance. The type of bag used for this test is U- shaped, 4-panel bags. Inlet selected is a duffle top with 3mil Polypropylene. The body fabric is white, and the safe working load is set to 2500lbs. If both bags survive PG 3 testing, then it will help us to order lower specification bag that lower the bag cost. For PG3 testing, we will be using Title 49 CFR for test references. The regulation for testing will be used under Part 178 subpart O which mentions testing of IBCs.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了两种不同规格的FIBC超级袋（超大型柔性中间散装容器）用于危险化学品包装的性能和成本效益，通过PG3 UN测试验证较低规格的袋子是否满足运输要求，以降低包装成本。
AI.research_question: 较低规格的FIBC超级袋能否通过PG3 UN测试并满足危险化学品运输要求，从而降低包装成本？
AI.motivation: 危险化学品的包装和运输需要符合严格的UN认证要求，而FIBC超级袋是化学工业中广泛使用的包装解决方案。不同规格的袋子成本差异显著，需要确定较低规格的袋子是否仍能满足安全要求，以实现成本节约。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美国运输部（DOT）危险材料法规（49 CFR Part 178 subpart O）和国际UN认证标准，重点关注包装性能标准、静电安全、材料完整性等理论框架。
AI.method: 采用比较分析方法，选择两种不同规格的FIBC超级袋（不同织物厚度、不同克重），按照PG3 UN测试标准进行性能测试，评估其是否符合危险化学品运输要求。
AI.findings: 通过PG3 UN测试比较两种规格袋子的性能，确定较低规格的袋子是否能够通过测试。如果通过，则证明较低成本的包装方案同样满足安全要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 为危险化学品包装的成本效益分析提供了实证研究框架，验证了在满足安全标准的前提下，通过优化包装规格实现成本节约的可能性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为化学工业提供了具体的包装解决方案选择指南，帮助企业通过选择合适规格的FIBC超级袋降低包装成本，同时确保符合DOT和UN法规要求。

title: A Regime-Aware Hybrid Pairs Trading System with Sentiment-Driven Intelligence
affiliations: Shri Guru Gobind Singhji Institute of Engineering and Technology, Shri Guru Gobind Singhji Institute of Engineering and Technology and Shri Guru Gobind Singhji Institute of Engineering and Technology

detail.title: A Regime-Aware Hybrid Pairs Trading System with Sentiment-Driven Intelligence
detail.abstract: Pairs trading, a widely used statistical arbitrage strategy, is often constrained by static pair selection methods and limited adaptability to dynamic market conditions. Existing approaches primarily focus on numerical indicators, neglecting the influence of market sentiment and collective behavioral patterns on trading outcomes. This paper proposes a hybrid pairs trading strategy (HPTS), formulated as a computational social system that integrates numerical indicators with sentiment-driven social signals to enable adaptive and robust trading decisions. HPTS combines sentiment analysis from financial news using the VADER model, a random forest-based pair selection guided by correlation and volatility, and a regime-aware sector rotation mechanism to align positions with bullish, bearish, and neutral market states. By embedding social signals into computational models, HPTS bridges quantitative finance with behavioral market dynamics, enhancing both adaptability and profitability. Empirical evaluation on historical equity datasets demonstrates that HPTS consistently outperforms conventional pairs trading methods, offering superior responsiveness to regime shifts, improved trade selection, and higher risk-adjusted returns. These results underscore the value of hybrid expert systems that fuse numerical and textual data for intelligent, resilient market strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合配对交易策略（HPTS），通过整合数值指标和情感驱动的社会信号，构建计算社会系统，以提升配对交易在动态市场中的适应性和盈利能力。
AI.research_question: 如何将市场情感和集体行为模式整合到配对交易策略中，以克服传统静态配对选择方法对动态市场条件适应性的限制？
AI.motivation: 传统配对交易策略受限于静态配对选择方法，对动态市场条件适应性不足，且现有方法主要关注数值指标，忽视了市场情感和集体行为模式对交易结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计算社会系统理论、行为金融学、市场情感分析理论、配对交易理论
AI.method: 混合配对交易策略（HPTS），包含：1）使用VADER模型进行金融新闻情感分析；2）基于随机森林的配对选择（考虑相关性和波动率）；3）基于市场状态的板块轮动机制（牛市、熊市、中性市场）
AI.findings: 在历史股票数据集上的实证评估表明，HPTS持续优于传统配对交易方法，表现出对市场状态转换的更好响应性、改进的交易选择能力以及更高的风险调整后收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将计算社会系统理论应用于配对交易，整合数值和文本数据；2）构建了连接量化金融与行为市场动力学的理论框架；3）提出了情感驱动的社会信号与数值指标融合的理论模型
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了具有实际应用价值的混合配对交易策略；2）提供了对市场状态转换更敏感的适应性交易系统；3）为金融机构提供了整合情感分析的投资决策工具；4）展示了融合数值和文本数据的智能市场策略的实际效益

title: Rapid source term estimation for multiple elevated leak sources using a Fast-AHPSOalgorithm: Application to industrial park emergency response
affiliations: Wuhan University, Wuhan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Wuhan University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University and Wuhan University

detail.title: Rapid source term estimation for multiple elevated leak sources using a Fast-AHPSOalgorithm: Application to industrial park emergency response
detail.abstract: Conventional source term estimation algorithms for elevated point sources are limited to single-source scenarios, failing to provide rapid and accurate quantification of multiple simultaneous releases during industrial accidents. Moreover, the classical Gaussian plume model exhibits poor adaptability under dynamic meteorological conditions and multi-source coupling. To overcome these limitations, as well as the premature convergence and long runtime of traditional particle swarm optimization (PSO) and its improved variant AHPSO, this paper proposes a fast source term estimation method based on an improved adaptive heterogeneous particle swarm optimization (Fast-AHPSO) tailored for emergency response. A multi-source coupled Gaussian plume correction model is developed by incorporating wind field functions, superposition mechanisms, and temperature–humidity corrections to enhance dispersion simulation accuracy for accidental releases. The Fast-AHPSO algorithm reduces computational time through less frequent altruistic operations and an early stopping mechanism. Experimental results show that Fast-AHPSO achieves high-precision source strength estimation under both clustered and dispersed source layouts, with average relative errors of 1.29\% and 0.22\%, respectively. Its runtime is approximately one-tenth that of AHPSO, greatly improving efficiency for real-time decision-making. The spatial distribution of sources significantly affects inversion accuracy: dispersed configurations yield smoother concentration fields and smaller gradients, leading to more accurate estimates. This study provides an efficient and reliable tool for rapid source term estimation of multiple elevated releases in industrial zones, with important implications for process safety enhancement and emergency response planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于改进自适应异构粒子群优化(Fast-AHPSO)的快速源项估计方法，用于工业事故中多个同时释放源的快速准确量化。该方法通过开发多源耦合高斯烟羽修正模型和改进优化算法，显著提高了计算效率和估计精度。
AI.research_question: 如何在动态气象条件和多源耦合情况下，快速准确地估计工业事故中多个同时释放的源项参数？
AI.motivation: 传统源项估计算法仅限于单源场景，无法快速准确量化工业事故中的多个同时释放；经典高斯烟羽模型在动态气象条件和多源耦合下适应性差；传统粒子群优化算法存在早熟收敛和计算时间长的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高斯烟羽模型、粒子群优化算法、自适应异构粒子群优化、多源耦合扩散理论、风场函数和温湿度修正机制。
AI.method: 开发多源耦合高斯烟羽修正模型（包含风场函数、叠加机制和温湿度修正），提出Fast-AHPSO算法（减少利他操作频率并引入提前停止机制），通过实验验证在聚集和分散源布局下的性能。
AI.findings: Fast-AHPSO在聚集和分散源布局下的平均相对误差分别为1.29%和0.22%；运行时间约为AHPSO的十分之一；空间分布显著影响反演精度，分散配置产生更平滑的浓度场和更小的梯度，从而获得更准确的估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多源耦合高斯烟羽修正模型，改进了自适应异构粒子群优化算法，建立了适用于动态气象条件和多源耦合的快速源项估计理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业区多个释放源的快速源项估计提供了高效可靠的工具，对过程安全增强和应急响应规划具有重要意义，能够支持实时决策制定。

title: Modern CEOs as political animals: How top leaders exercise their power and influence
affiliations: Florida Atlantic University and Florida Atlantic University

detail.title: Modern CEOs as political animals: How top leaders exercise their power and influence
detail.abstract: CEOs increasingly operate in an arena (i.e., politics) once reserved for politicians, prompting The Economist to wonder whether they are arbiters of rights and wrongs. Yet many models of what CEOs do (i.e., managerial role theory) focus on the functional orientation of executive work, distinguishing three clusters of executive roles: interpersonal, informational, and decisional. We argue that an update to Mintzberg’s (1973) typology is needed to remedy the peripheral account of politics; we propose adding CEOs’ political role as an additional cluster. We also draw on corporate political activity and CEO sociopolitical activism research to conceptualize this role as comprising four sub-categories (advocate, influencer, broker, and architect) and help us account for the motivational sources of CEOs’ political engagement. By fulfilling these sub-roles, modern CEOs actively participate in moral debates, shape public discourse, act as liaisons between firms and political actors, and design favorable “rules of the game.” In terms of contribution, this paper adds the CEO’s political role to Mintzberg’s model. Second, it brings morality to managerial role theory by considering the ideological commitments of executive action. Third, it reconciles intrinsic and extrinsic motivations underlying political engagement and broadens the consequences of CEOs’ political engagement to include societal implications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出需要更新Mintzberg的管理角色理论，增加CEO的政治角色作为第四个集群，以解释CEO在现代社会中日益增长的政治参与和道德仲裁作用。
AI.research_question: CEO在现代社会中扮演什么样的政治角色？如何将政治角色整合到现有的管理角色理论框架中？
AI.motivation: CEO越来越多地参与政治领域，甚至成为道德仲裁者，但传统的管理角色理论（如Mintzberg模型）主要关注功能性角色，对政治角色的描述不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: Mintzberg的管理角色理论（人际、信息和决策角色）、企业政治活动研究、CEO社会政治活动研究。
AI.method: 理论构建和概念发展，基于现有文献整合和理论扩展。
AI.findings: 提出CEO政治角色包含四个子类别：倡导者、影响者、中间人和架构师。通过这些角色，CEO参与道德辩论、塑造公共话语、连接企业与政治行为者、设计有利的"游戏规则"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将CEO政治角色添加到Mintzberg模型中；2. 通过考虑高管行动的意识形态承诺，将道德维度引入管理角色理论；3. 调和政治参与的内在和外在动机，并将CEO政治参与的后果扩展到社会影响层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助企业和CEO更好地理解和应对政治参与的角色，为高管培训和发展提供理论指导，促进对社会责任和政治参与的更全面理解。

title: RL-based collaborative warranty and condition-based random inspection for stochastically degrading mission-critical systems
affiliations: Foshan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Qingdao University of Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: RL-based collaborative warranty and condition-based random inspection for stochastically degrading mission-critical systems
detail.abstract: This study tackles the challenges of managing the reliability of stochastically degrading mission-critical systems by proposing an integrated lifecycle framework that combines in-warranty collaborative warranty models with out-of-warranty maintenance strategies. At its core lies the condition-based random collaborative warranty with heterogeneous preventive maintenance (CBRCW-HPM), a user-manufacturer collaborative governance mechanism that categorizes system degradation into light, moderate, and failure states. It formulates state transition probabilities along with cost- and time-related metrics and adopts the reinforcement learning–based online Dyna algorithm to provide accurate warranty cost estimation, thereby enabling adaptability to non-unique initial and terminal states. Warranty pricing is innovatively formulated using the Cobb–Douglas production function, treating warranties as independent value-added services. Complementing this, the bivariate condition-based random inspection (BCBRI) strategy leverages in-warranty operational performance data to classify out-of-warranty systems into high- and low-frequency failure types and optimizes long-term cost rates via the renewal reward theorem through scenario-tailored maintenance actions. Numerical results validate the proposed approaches, and case studies further verify that CBRCW-HPM outperforms fixed-interval warranty models, while BCBRI surpasses fixed-interval inspection schemes in adaptability and cost-effectiveness. This integrated solution effectively meets the core requirements of data-driven reliability management for mission-critical systems in the advanced digital technology era.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个集成生命周期框架，结合保修期内的协作保修模型和保修期外的维护策略，通过CBRCW-HPM保修机制和BCBRI检查策略，优化关键任务系统的可靠性管理。
AI.research_question: 如何有效管理随机退化关键任务系统的可靠性？如何整合保修期内协作保修模型与保修期外维护策略来优化系统全生命周期管理？
AI.motivation: 关键任务系统在随机退化过程中面临可靠性管理挑战，需要适应非唯一初始和终止状态的灵活解决方案，以及在先进数字技术时代满足数据驱动可靠性管理的核心需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于状态的条件随机协作保修理论、Cobb-Douglas生产函数用于保修定价、更新奖励定理用于长期成本优化、强化学习Dyna算法用于在线估计。
AI.method: 提出CBRCW-HPM保修机制（将系统退化分为轻度、中度、故障状态），采用基于强化学习的Dyna算法进行保修成本估计；提出BCBRI检查策略，利用保修期运行数据分类系统故障类型，通过更新奖励定理优化长期成本率。
AI.findings: 数值结果验证了所提方法的有效性：CBRCW-HPM优于固定间隔保修模型，BCBRI在适应性和成本效益方面超过固定间隔检查方案，集成解决方案有效满足数据驱动可靠性管理需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出集成生命周期可靠性管理框架；2) 创新使用Cobb-Douglas生产函数进行保修定价；3) 将强化学习Dyna算法应用于保修成本估计；4) 建立状态转移概率和成本时间指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为制造商提供更准确的保修成本估计工具；2) 为用户提供适应性更强的保修和维护策略；3) 帮助企业优化关键任务系统的全生命周期管理成本；4) 支持数据驱动的可靠性决策。

title: A Deployment-Oriented Framework for Evaluating Streaming Integrity Alerting Under Workload Constraints
affiliations: Cornell University

detail.title: A Deployment-Oriented Framework for Evaluating Streaming Integrity Alerting Under Workload Constraints
detail.abstract: Streaming monitoring systems are deployed as alerting systems, not as score generators alone. In these settings, evaluation must answer not only whether incidents receive high scores, but whether the realized alert stream changes under corruption, responds in time to matter, and remains workload-safe under nonstationarity. We present a reproducible, deployment-oriented framework for evaluating streaming alerting systems that treats the realized score-to-warning-to-episode pipeline as the evaluated object. The framework combines paired clean/corrupted replay for counterfactual alert impact, matched-burden event timeliness, explicit feasible-versus-infeasible operating regions under episode-budget and time-in-warning (TIW) constraints, and regime-sliced compliance audits. For adaptive policies, the framework preserves counterfactual parity by learning the clean-replay threshold schedule once and replaying it unchanged on corrupted streams at identical timestamps. Across a primary financial-services monitoring panel and two telemetry replications, feasibility emerges as a first-class result: operating points that appear attractive under score-centric or unconstrained views can become non-deployable once workload constraints are enforced. In the primary Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) setting, median budget-only matched-burden coverage is 0.844, but median joint coverage after enforcing TIW falls to 0.025, showing that TIW is the binding safety constraint. Online recalibration preserves the narrow surviving feasible region that static calibration removes. Results on NASA SMAP A-1 and D-15 further show that although the best detector family varies by panel, framework-level conclusions transport across domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向部署的流式警报系统评估框架，强调在真实工作负载约束下评估警报系统的可行性，而不仅仅是评分性能。框架包含配对干净/污染重放、匹配负担事件及时性、明确可行/不可行操作区域等组件，在金融和遥测数据上验证了可行性作为首要结果的重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何评估流式监控警报系统在真实部署环境中的表现，而不仅仅是作为评分生成器？具体来说，如何评估警报流在数据污染下的变化、响应及时性以及在非平稳性下的工作负载安全性？
AI.motivation: 流式监控系统是作为警报系统部署的，而不仅仅是评分生成器。现有评估方法主要关注评分性能，但忽略了实际部署中的关键问题：警报流是否因数据污染而改变、是否及时响应、在非平稳性下是否保持工作负载安全。需要一种面向部署的评估框架来回答这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 将实现的"评分-警告-事件"管道作为评估对象；2) 配对干净/污染重放用于反事实警报影响分析；3) 匹配负担事件及时性评估；4) 在事件预算和时间在警告(TIW)约束下明确可行与不可行操作区域；5) 制度切片合规审计；6) 对于自适应策略，通过一次学习干净重放阈值计划并在污染流上相同时间戳重放来保持反事实对等性。
AI.method: 提出了一个可重现、面向部署的评估框架，包含：配对干净/污染重放、匹配负担事件及时性、明确可行/不可行操作区域、制度切片合规审计。在主要金融服务监控面板和两个遥测复制数据集上进行验证，包括消费者金融保护局(CFPB)、NASA SMAP A-1和D-15数据集。
AI.findings: 1) 可行性成为首要结果：在评分中心或无约束视图中看似有吸引力的操作点，一旦强制执行工作负载约束就可能变得不可部署；2) 在CFPB设置中，仅考虑预算的匹配负担覆盖中位数为0.844，但强制执行TIW后的联合覆盖中位数降至0.025，表明TIW是绑定安全约束；3) 在线重新校准保留了静态校准消除的狭窄存活可行区域；4) 最佳检测器家族因面板而异，但框架级结论可跨领域转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了第一个将实现的"评分-警告-事件"管道作为评估对象的流式警报系统评估框架；2) 引入了反事实对等性概念，确保自适应策略评估的公平性；3) 将可行性作为评估的首要结果，强调工作负载约束的重要性；4) 提供了跨领域可转移的评估方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为实际部署的流式监控系统提供了实用的评估工具；2) 帮助组织识别在真实工作负载约束下可行的操作点；3) 揭示了时间在警告(TIW)约束作为主要安全限制因素的重要性；4) 支持在线重新校准以保持可行操作区域；5) 框架可应用于金融、遥测等多个领域。

title: One Says Goodbye, Another Says Hello: Turnover and Compensation in the Early Care and Education Sector
affiliations: Rice University and Rice University

detail.title: One Says Goodbye, Another Says Hello: Turnover and Compensation in the Early Care and Education Sector
detail.abstract: We study turnover and compensation in the early care and education (ECE) sector using linked administrative records from three Texas state agencies that allow us to follow nearly three million individuals from high school through their labor market careers. We match each ECE worker to observationally equivalent workers who never entered the sector and estimate turnover and earnings differentials under multiple definitions. ECE workers exhibit 5–7 percentage points higher turnover and approximately 45% lower earnings than matched counterparts. We decompose these differentials into worker selection and sector effects. For turnover, selection dominates: workers who enter ECE exhibit higher turnover across all sectors, but ECE employment itself is associated with lower turnover, consistent with compensating amenities that partially stabilize an inherently unstable workforce. For earnings, both selection and sector effects contribute roughly equally to the penalty. The differentials vary substantially by race and education, with college-educated white workers facing the largest gaps. Approximately half of ECE leavers exit formal employment entirely, suggesting that turnover does not primarily reflect efficient reallocation.

AI.tldr: 使用德克萨斯州行政记录追踪近300万个体，研究发现早期教育与保育（ECE）工作者比匹配对照组有5-7%更高的离职率和约45%更低的收入。离职率差异主要源于工作者选择效应，而收入差距则由选择和行业效应共同导致。
AI.research_question: 早期教育与保育（ECE）行业的工作者离职率和收入差距有多大？这些差距在多大程度上源于工作者选择效应（selection）与行业特定效应（sector effects）？这些差异在不同种族和教育背景的群体中如何变化？
AI.motivation: 早期教育与保育（ECE）行业面临严重的人员流动和低工资问题，这对儿童发展和服务质量有重要影响。然而，缺乏大规模纵向数据来准确衡量这些差距及其成因，特别是区分工作者自身特征与行业特定因素的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场匹配理论和工作搜寻理论，采用反事实分析框架，通过匹配ECE工作者与从未进入该行业的观察上相似的工作者，分解离职率和收入差距的选择效应和行业效应。
AI.method: 使用德克萨斯州三个政府机构的关联行政记录，追踪近300万个体从高中到劳动力市场的完整职业生涯。采用倾向得分匹配方法，将每位ECE工作者与从未进入ECE行业的观察特征相似的工作者进行匹配，估计离职率和收入差异，并进行Oaxaca-Blinder分解。
AI.findings: 1. ECE工作者比匹配对照组离职率高5-7%，收入低约45%；2. 离职率差异主要由选择效应主导：进入ECE的工作者本身在所有行业都表现出更高的离职倾向，但ECE就业本身与较低的离职率相关；3. 收入差距中，选择效应和行业效应贡献大致相等；4. 差异因种族和教育程度而异，大学教育的白人工作者差距最大；5. 约一半ECE离职者完全退出正规就业。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次大规模实证分解ECE行业离职率和收入差距的选择与行业效应；2. 发现ECE就业本身具有稳定效应，支持补偿性便利设施理论；3. 揭示了不同人口群体在ECE劳动力市场中的异质性经历；4. 挑战了离职反映有效重新配置的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为ECE政策制定者提供精确的离职率和收入差距估计；2. 表明提高ECE工资可能同时吸引更稳定的工作者和改善行业条件；3. 揭示需要针对不同人口群体的差异化干预策略；4. 指出需要关注ECE离职者的就业过渡支持。

title: Deterrence through Restraint: Alliance Politics and Gulf Security under Extended Deterrence
affiliations: Abu Dhabi University

detail.title: Deterrence through Restraint: Alliance Politics and Gulf Security under Extended Deterrence
detail.abstract: This essay explains why attacked states sometimes rationally choose not to retaliate. Existing deterrence theory often treats nonresponse as evidence of weakness, irresolution, or deterrence failure. I argue that in patron-backed security orders, nonretaliation can instead serve coalition preservation. When local retaliation would widen the conflict, raise the patron's political or military costs, or expose critical infrastructure to additional punishment, strategic restraint may strengthen extended deterrence rather than weaken it. The argument complements work on alliance credibility, crisis bargaining, and military restraint by shifting attention from prewar bargaining to the post-attack choices of a protected state. I illustrate the mechanism with three Gulf-centered episodes: Israel's restraint during the 1991 Gulf War, Saudi Arabia's nonretaliation after the 2019 Abqaiq attacks, and the United Arab Emirates' calibrated response to the 2022 Abu Dhabi strikes. The essay concludes by applying the argument to a future U.S.-Iran contingency in which Iran attacks GCC states to fracture a U.S.-led coalition.

AI.tldr: 该论文解释了为什么受攻击国家有时理性选择不报复。现有威慑理论常将不回应视为软弱、优柔寡断或威慑失败的证据。作者认为，在庇护国支持的安全秩序中，不报复反而可以服务于联盟维护。
AI.research_question: 为什么在庇护国支持的安全秩序中，受攻击国家有时理性选择不报复？
AI.motivation: 现有威慑理论存在缺陷，常将不回应视为软弱或威慑失败，未能解释在庇护国支持的安全秩序中战略克制的理性逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 威慑理论、联盟可信性理论、危机谈判理论、军事克制理论，特别关注从战前谈判转向受保护国家在遭受攻击后的选择。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析三个海湾地区事件：1991年海湾战争期间以色列的克制、2019年Abqaiq袭击后沙特的不报复、2022年阿布扎比袭击后阿联酋的校准性回应。
AI.findings: 当地方报复会扩大冲突、增加庇护国的政治或军事成本、或暴露关键基础设施遭受额外惩罚时，战略克制可能加强延伸威慑而非削弱它。不报复可以服务于联盟维护目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了联盟可信性、危机谈判和军事克制理论，将关注点从战前谈判转向受攻击国家的战后选择，为威慑理论提供了新的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在庇护国支持的安全秩序中理性选择战略克制的理论依据，并应用于未来美国-伊朗可能发生的冲突情境分析。

title: An Integrated Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Joint Probabilistic Forecasting and Risk-Aware Decision Support for Perishable Agricultural Commodities
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: An Integrated Multimodal Deep Learning Framework for Joint Probabilistic Forecasting and Risk-Aware Decision Support for Perishable Agricultural Commodities
detail.abstract: Specialty crops operate under compressed biological cycles and high perishability, requiring risk-aware decision support. This study presents a fully automated deep learning (DL) framework for joint probabilistic forecasting of daily asparagus yield and price as a representative test case using open-access data. The system integrates live API ingestion of meteorological and market data, a multimodal model zoo, and a Monte Carlo (MC) harvest optimization engine that models yield–price correlation through a Gaussian copula.The framework was validated across two climatically contrasting regions—California and Michigan—using an independent 2025 test set. Attention-based models outperformed SARIMA baselines, reducing forecast errors by 21–31%. Multi-horizon evaluation (1–14 days) revealed minimal temporal degradation, enabling reliable two-week operational planning. Probabilistic yield forecasts achieved near-target calibration (coverage ~80 – 90%), while price forecasts captured central trends alongside market volatility.Embedding these forecasts into a stochastic optimization model translated predictive gains into economic value. The optimized strategy significantly increased expected daily profit compared to historical baselines—up to +119% in California and +2,614% at short horizons in Michigan—while reducing loss probability to near zero. By bridging predictive analytics with prescriptive decision support, this scalable digital twin framework provides a practical pathway toward resilient harvest management under increasing climatic and market volatility, particularly for smallholder operations that lack high-cost infrastructure or expensive private data subscriptions.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个完全自动化的深度学习框架，用于联合概率预测芦笋产量和价格，并通过蒙特卡洛优化引擎提升采收决策的经济效益。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个自动化框架来联合概率预测特色作物的产量和价格，并将预测结果转化为优化的采收决策，以应对气候和市场波动？
AI.motivation: 特色作物具有压缩的生物周期和高易腐性，需要风险感知的决策支持。小规模农户缺乏高成本基础设施或昂贵的私人数据订阅，面临日益增加的气候和市场波动挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习预测模型、注意力机制、高斯copula建模产量-价格相关性、蒙特卡洛随机优化、数字孪生框架
AI.method: 1) 实时API获取气象和市场数据；2) 多模态模型库；3) 使用高斯copula建模产量-价格相关性的蒙特卡洛采收优化引擎；4) 在加利福尼亚和密歇根两个气候对比区域验证；5) 使用独立2025年测试集；6) 多时间范围评估（1-14天）
AI.findings: 1) 注意力模型优于SARIMA基线，减少预测误差21-31%；2) 多时间范围评估显示时间退化最小，支持可靠的两周运营规划；3) 概率产量预测实现接近目标校准（覆盖率80-90%）；4) 价格预测捕捉中心趋势和市场波动；5) 优化策略显著提高预期日利润（加州+119%，密歇根短期+2,614%），同时将损失概率降至接近零
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 开发了首个完全自动化的深度学习框架用于特色作物产量和价格的联合概率预测；2) 提出了通过高斯copula建模产量-价格相关性的方法；3) 建立了将预测分析转化为处方决策支持的可扩展数字孪生框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为小规模农户提供实用的采收管理工具，无需高成本基础设施；2) 使用开放访问数据，降低数据获取成本；3) 提高运营利润同时降低风险；4) 支持两周运营规划，增强供应链韧性；5) 可扩展到其他特色作物

title: A Unified Control Architecture for Macro-Micro Manipulation using a Active Remote Center of Compliance for Manufacturing Applications
affiliations: Karlsruhe University of Applied Sciences and Karlsruhe University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: A Unified Control Architecture for Macro-Micro Manipulation using a Active Remote Center of Compliance for Manufacturing Applications
detail.abstract: Macro-micro manipulators combine a macro manipulator with a large workspace, such as an industrial robot, with a lightweight, high-bandwidth micro manipulator. This enables highly dynamic interaction control while preserving the wide workspace of the robot. Traditionally, position control is assigned to the macro manipulator, while the micro manipulator handles the interaction with the environment, limiting the achievable interaction control bandwidth. To solve this, we propose a novel control architecture that incorporates the macro manipulator into the active interaction control. This leads to a increase in control bandwidth by a factor of 2.1 compared to the state of the art architecture, based on the leader-follower approach and factor 12.5 compared to traditional robot-based force control. Further we propose surrogate models for a more efficient controller design and easy adaptation to hardware changes. We validate our approach by comparing it against the other control schemes in different experiments, like collision with an object, following a force trajectory and industrial assembly tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的宏-微机械臂控制架构，将宏机械臂纳入主动交互控制，相比现有技术将控制带宽提高了2.1倍，相比传统机器人力控制提高了12.5倍，并提出了代理模型以简化控制器设计和硬件适配。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种控制架构，将宏机械臂纳入主动交互控制，以提高宏-微机械臂系统的交互控制带宽？
AI.motivation: 传统宏-微机械臂系统中，位置控制分配给宏机械臂，微机械臂处理环境交互，这限制了可实现的交互控制带宽。需要解决这一限制以提高系统性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏-微机械臂系统控制理论，主动交互控制理论，控制带宽优化理论
AI.method: 提出新颖的控制架构，将宏机械臂纳入主动交互控制；开发代理模型以简化控制器设计和硬件适配；通过实验验证（包括物体碰撞、力轨迹跟踪和工业装配任务）
AI.findings: 新架构相比基于领导者-跟随者方法的最先进架构，控制带宽提高了2.1倍；相比传统机器人力控制提高了12.5倍；代理模型能有效简化控制器设计和硬件适配
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将宏机械臂纳入主动交互控制的新理论框架；发展了宏-微机械臂系统控制带宽优化的新方法；建立了代理模型在控制器设计中的应用理论
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了控制带宽的显著提升；提供了更高效的控制器设计方法；使系统更容易适应硬件变化；在工业装配等实际任务中验证了有效性

title: Testing Weak-Form Market Efficiency in MENA Equity Markets: Evidence from Traditional Econometrics and Machine Learning Approaches
affiliations: Ain Shams University

detail.title: Testing Weak-Form Market Efficiency in MENA Equity Markets: Evidence from Traditional Econometrics and Machine Learning Approaches

keywords: for research emphasis: Efficient market hypothesis (EMH)

detail.abstract: This study tests the weak-form Efficient Market Hypothesis across eleven MENA stock markets. This study employed traditional statistical, technical trading rule, and machine-learning tests. The descriptive analysis reveals that most of these markets exhibit return distributions that deviate from normality. These patterns resemble emerging markets and indicate possible underlying inefficiencies. Non-parametric Runs Tests and Q-tests yield inconclusive results; Bahrain, the UAE, and Lebanon exhibit significant serial dependence, whereas other markets seem random. Variance Ratio tests show that markets are different from each other. Unit root tests show that prices are not stable, but returns are stable. Trading strategies based on RSI don't consistently make abnormal returns, but RFC model show that many markets, especially Tunisia, Egypt, Qatar, Israel, Morocco, and Saudi Arabia, are very predictable. Overall, the results show that weak form efficiency is not the same in all MENA markets, and that some of them are not efficient.

AI.tldr: 该研究对11个中东和北非(MENA)股票市场的弱式有效市场假说进行了检验，发现这些市场的有效性存在差异，部分市场表现出可预测性，表明并非所有MENA市场都满足弱式有效性。
AI.research_question: 中东和北亚(MENA)地区的11个股票市场是否满足弱式有效市场假说？
AI.motivation: 检验新兴市场特别是MENA地区股票市场的有效性，了解这些市场的效率特征，为投资者和政策制定者提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弱式有效市场假说(EMH)，技术分析理论，机器学习预测模型。
AI.method: 采用传统统计检验(描述性分析、游程检验、Q检验、方差比检验、单位根检验)、技术交易规则(RSI策略)和机器学习方法(RFC模型)进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 1) 大多数MENA市场收益率分布偏离正态分布，类似新兴市场特征；2) 不同检验结果不一致：巴林、阿联酋、黎巴嫩存在显著序列相关性，其他市场看似随机；3) 方差比检验显示市场间存在差异；4) 价格序列不稳定但收益率稳定；5) RSI策略无法持续获得超额收益，但RFC模型显示多个市场(特别是突尼斯、埃及、卡塔尔、以色列、摩洛哥、沙特阿拉伯)具有高度可预测性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为弱式有效市场假说在新兴市场的适用性提供实证证据；2) 揭示了不同检验方法对市场有效性判断的差异；3) 展示了机器学习方法在检验市场有效性方面的优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供MENA市场投资策略参考；2) 帮助政策制定者了解市场效率状况；3) 为监管机构改进市场机制提供依据；4) 展示了机器学习在金融预测中的实际应用价值。

title: Knowledge Creation in Cross Cultural Product Design: A Study on Translating Two Cultural Heritages into Innovative Furniture Design
affiliations: Pelita Harapan University, Indonesia

detail.title: Knowledge Creation in Cross Cultural Product Design: A Study on Translating Two Cultural Heritages into Innovative Furniture Design
detail.abstract: To bring a unique value proposition to the global market, designers continuously seek new perspectives to incorporate into their designs, one of which is culture. This study proposes crossing two cultures as a source of design inspiration.The study proposes a framework to guide design students throughout the process with 5 key stages: investigate, define, translate, prototype and validate. It is implemented through a cross-cultural furniture design project between Universitas Pelita Harapan (Indonesia) and Seoul National University of Science and Technology (Korea) in which the 32 students should design furniture design by taking inspiration from traditonal toys of Indonesia and Korea. The study further investigates knowledge creation across five stages through the lens of the SECI knowledge creation model. The findings reveal that each CPD stage is characterized by distinct modes of knowledge creation that emerged from a dynamic interaction between tacit and explicit knowledge.  Based on these findings, the study proposes some key design capabilities that should be nurtured by design educators in cross cultural project-based learning

AI.tldr: 本研究提出跨文化设计框架，通过印尼与韩国学生的家具设计合作项目，探讨文化交叉作为设计灵感来源，并分析知识创造过程。
AI.research_question: 如何通过跨文化设计项目促进设计学生的知识创造？跨文化设计过程中的知识创造模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 设计师需要不断寻找新的视角为全球市场创造独特价值主张，文化是重要灵感来源。跨文化设计能激发创新，但需要系统指导框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: SECI知识创造模型（社会化、外化、组合化、内化），跨文化设计理论，项目式学习理论。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，实施印尼UPH大学与韩国首尔科技大学32名学生的跨文化家具设计项目，通过5阶段框架（调查、定义、转化、原型、验证）指导设计过程。
AI.findings: 每个跨文化设计阶段都呈现出独特的知识创造模式，这些模式源于隐性知识与显性知识之间的动态互动。跨文化项目促进了知识的社会化、外化、组合化和内化过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 将SECI知识创造模型应用于跨文化设计教育，揭示了设计过程中知识转化的动态机制，丰富了跨文化设计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出5阶段跨文化设计框架，识别了设计教育者应培养的关键设计能力，为跨文化项目式学习提供实践指导。

title: The Economics of Asymmetric Attrition: A Quantitative Analysis of Low-Cost Drone Warfare in the Ukraine and Iranian Shahed Programs (2022–2026)

detail.title: The Economics of Asymmetric Attrition: A Quantitative Analysis of Low-Cost Drone Warfare in the Ukraine and Iranian Shahed Programs (2022–2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author has no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Secondary data use only. No human subjects. Approval granted.
declarations.funderStatement: Research Funded by ICL Institute, New Jersey, USA.

detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of low-cost unmanned aerial systems (UAS) has fundamentally disrupted the economic calculus of modern warfare, creating unprecedented cost-exchange asymmetries that challenge traditional defense paradigms. This dissertation investigates the economics of asymmetric attrition through a quantitative analysis of low-cost drone warfare in the Ukrainian and Iranian Shahed programs between 2022 and 2026. The study employs a mixed-methods research design integrating cost-effectiveness analysis, time-series modeling, regression analysis, and comparative economic assessment using publicly available datasets from Oryx, SIPRI, ACLED, and CNAS. Key findings reveal profound cost-exchange ratios that favor drone operators: Patriot-versus-Shahed interceptions demonstrate a 190:1 cost-exchange ratio disadvantaging defenders, while Ukrainian First-Person View (FPV) drones achieve extraordinary return-on-investment ratios ranging from 2,000:1 to 250,000:1 depending on target value. Cost-effectiveness analysis demonstrates that FPV drones achieve approximately $1,036 per successful strike compared to $269,258 for Shahed systems, rendering Ukrainian decentralized production 200 to 3,000 times more cost-effective per target destroyed. Time-series analysis reveals approximately 7% monthly growth in drone employment intensity, while Shahed interception rates declined from 88.7% to 70% as saturation tactics evolved. Regression modeling (R² = 0.829) identifies target value and drone type as the most significant predictors of cost-exchange outcomes. The comparative analysis highlights fundamental differences between Ukrainian bottom-up innovation ecosystems ($300-$500 per FPV unit) and Iranian state-directed production models ($20,000-$80,000 per Shahed). These findings carry profound implications for U.S. defense acquisition strategies, force structure optimization, and Department of War budget allocation, suggesting that the economics of asymmetric attrition represent a paradigm shift in military competition requiring fundamental reassessment of current procurement and operational doctrines.

AI.tldr: 低成本无人机系统（UAS）正在颠覆现代战争的经济计算，创造前所未有的成本交换不对称。本研究通过定量分析2022-2026年乌克兰和伊朗Shahed项目的低成本无人机战争，发现无人机操作者具有显著成本优势：爱国者拦截Shahed的成本交换比为190:1，乌克兰FPV无人机的投资回报比达2,000:1至250,000:1。乌克兰分散化生产比伊朗国家主导模式成本效益高200-3,000倍。
AI.research_question: 低成本无人机战争如何创造不对称消耗的经济优势？乌克兰和伊朗无人机项目的成本效益差异及其对国防战略的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 低成本无人机的快速扩散正在颠覆现代战争的经济计算，创造前所未有的成本交换不对称，挑战传统防御范式，需要对不对称消耗经济学进行系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不对称战争理论、成本效益分析理论、军事经济学、创新生态系统理论、国防采购理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究设计：成本效益分析、时间序列建模、回归分析、比较经济评估，使用Oryx、SIPRI、ACLED、CNAS等公开数据集
AI.findings: 1. 爱国者拦截Shahed的成本交换比为190:1，防御方处于劣势；2. 乌克兰FPV无人机投资回报比达2,000:1至250,000:1；3. 乌克兰FPV每次成功打击成本约1,036美元，Shahed系统为269,258美元；4. 乌克兰分散化生产比伊朗模式成本效益高200-3,000倍；5. 无人机使用强度每月增长约7%；6. Shahed拦截率从88.7%降至70%；7. 目标价值和无人机类型是成本交换结果的最显著预测因素（R²=0.829）
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了不对称消耗经济学理论框架；2. 量化了低成本无人机战争的成本交换不对称性；3. 比较了不同创新生态系统（自下而上vs国家主导）的经济效率差异；4. 为军事竞争范式转变提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为美国国防采购策略提供数据支持；2. 指导部队结构优化；3. 影响国防部预算分配；4. 建议重新评估当前采购和作战条令；5. 为应对低成本无人机威胁提供战略建议

title: Interpretable Pavement Roughness Prediction in Southeast Texas Using Input Variable Selection and Flooding and Ground Deformation Exposure
affiliations: Lamar University, Lamar University, McGill University, McGill University, Lamar University, Lamar University, Kangwon National University, Lamar University and Lamar University

detail.title: Interpretable Pavement Roughness Prediction in Southeast Texas Using Input Variable Selection and Flooding and Ground Deformation Exposure
detail.abstract: Prediction of pavement roughness is central to network-level planning, yet environmental stressors remain underrepresented in data-driven models. This study develops an input variable selection and ensemble-learning workflow to predict the International Roughness Index (IRI) and support network-level identification of deterioration risk. Segment-level roadway data for Beaumont, Texas (2019–2023; ≈11,900 segments) integrate pavement condition surveys, design and geometry attributes, maintenance and rehabilitation (M&R) records, and environmental layers describing flood inundation depth and velocity, flood susceptibility, topographic convergence, and ground deformation. Edgeworth-approximation Conditional Mutual Information (EA-CMI) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are used to screen and interpret predictors, and Random Forest and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) are evaluated against a linear baseline. XGBoost achieves the strongest performance (R² ≈ 0.79 in 2019; R² ≈ 0.73 in 2023), while a SHAP-guided reduced model retains near-parity accuracy with fewer inputs, lowering data demands for practical deployment. Inter-year transfer of the model trained on the 2019 data to the 2023 observations reveals temporal drift, with larger errors concentrated among the most distressed segments. EA-CMI prioritizes structural and distress-related variables while mitigating redundancy before model fitting, and SHAP corroborates the dominant role of distress indicators while highlighting interaction patterns associated with flooding and deformation. Spatial diagnostics indicate clustering in both roughness change and transfer residuals, with deterioration corridors more frequently co-located with high flood exposure and ground movement, whereas spatially coherent improvements are more consistent with recent M&R. Overall, the workflow supports updating and interpretation of roughness predictions for resilience-oriented pavement management in hazard-prone regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个输入变量选择和集成学习工作流程，用于预测国际平整度指数（IRI），支持网络级路面恶化风险识别。通过整合路面状况、设计几何属性、维护修复记录和环境因素（洪水、地形、地面变形），使用EA-CMI和SHAP方法筛选和解释预测变量。XGBoost模型表现最佳，SHAP引导的简化模型在减少输入变量的同时保持相近精度。研究发现时间漂移现象，且恶化路段与高洪水暴露和地面运动密切相关。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个有效的数据驱动工作流程来预测路面平整度（IRI），并识别网络级路面恶化风险，特别是在环境压力因素代表性不足的情况下？
AI.motivation: 路面平整度预测对网络级规划至关重要，但现有数据驱动模型中环境压力因素的代表性不足。需要开发能够整合环境因素（如洪水、地面变形）的预测模型，以支持灾害易发地区的韧性路面管理。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 集成学习理论（随机森林、XGBoost）
2. 信息论方法（Edgeworth近似条件互信息，EA-CMI）
3. 可解释人工智能（SHAP值分析）
4. 空间统计分析（空间聚类诊断）
5. 时间序列分析（模型时间漂移）
AI.method:
1. 数据收集：德克萨斯州博蒙特市路段级数据（2019-2023年，约11,900个路段），包括路面状况调查、设计几何属性、维护修复记录、环境层数据（洪水淹没深度和速度、洪水敏感性、地形收敛性、地面变形）
2. 变量选择：使用EA-CMI筛选预测变量并减少冗余
3. 模型构建：评估随机森林和XGBoost，以线性模型为基准
4. 模型解释：使用SHAP值分析变量重要性和交互模式
5. 时间转移分析：将2019年训练的模型应用于2023年数据
6. 空间诊断：分析粗糙度变化和转移残差的空间聚类
AI.findings:
1. XGBoost模型表现最佳（2019年R²≈0.79，2023年R²≈0.73）
2. SHAP引导的简化模型在减少输入变量的同时保持相近精度
3. 时间漂移现象：将2019年模型应用于2023年数据时误差较大，特别是在最恶化的路段
4. EA-CMI优先选择结构和损坏相关变量，有效减少冗余
5. SHAP分析确认损坏指标的主导作用，并突出洪水与变形相关的交互模式
6. 空间诊断显示粗糙度变化和转移残差存在聚类，恶化走廊更常与高洪水暴露和地面运动共位，而空间一致性的改善与近期维护修复更相关
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了结合EA-CMI变量选择和SHAP解释的集成学习工作流程
2. 发展了环境因素（洪水、地面变形）在路面平整度预测中的整合方法
3. 提供了时间漂移分析框架，识别模型在时间维度上的稳定性问题
4. 建立了空间聚类诊断方法，揭示路面恶化与环境风险的空间关联模式
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 开发了实用的路面平整度预测工作流程，支持网络级路面管理决策
2. 提供了简化模型方案，降低数据需求，便于实际部署
3. 识别了洪水暴露和地面运动对路面恶化的关键影响，支持灾害易发地区的韧性路面管理
4. 为路面维护修复优先级确定提供了数据驱动的方法
5. 支持路面管理系统的更新和解释，提高预测的透明度和可信度

title: Research on Eco-Driving Strategy of Connected Hybrid Electric Vehicles for Traffic Influence Factors
affiliations: Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou Business College and Wenzhou University

detail.title: Research on Eco-Driving Strategy of Connected Hybrid Electric Vehicles for Traffic Influence Factors
detail.abstract: Abstract ：Eco-driving technology is the core means to improve the energy economy and traffic efficiency of connected hybrid electric vehicles. Existing studies mostly focus on the coupling of speed planning and energy management in car-following scenarios, and there are still deficiencies in relevant research on fuel cell hybrid electric vehicles under complex traffic environments. This study proposes a hierarchical eco-driving strategy that integrates speed planning and energy management to achieve multi-objective optimization. Firstly, a driving environment model is constructed based on real traffic scenarios, and the passing reference speed is solved by comprehensively considering road condition information such as signalized crossroadss. Then, a multi-objective cost function is constructed based on the model predictive control framework to realize vehicle speed optimization. The speed condition is transmitted to the Energy Management System (EMS). At the energy management level, an improved Adaptive Noise TD3 (AN-TD3) algorithm integrating an adaptive noise mechanism is proposed, and a comprehensive reward function considering hydrogen consumption cost and component aging is designed to realize the optimal power distribution between the fuel cell and the lithium battery. The joint simulation verification based on MATLAB/Simulink and SUMO shows that the proposed strategy significantly shortens the travel time, reduces the number of vehicle starts and stops and energy consumption. The AN-TD3 algorithm has a faster convergence speed than the traditional Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithm, the hydrogen consumption is close to the global optimal of dynamic programming, which effectively suppresses the aging of fuel cells and lithium batteries, and improves the economy and robustness of the whole vehicle operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层生态驾驶策略，将速度规划与能量管理相结合，用于燃料电池混合动力电动汽车在复杂交通环境中的多目标优化，显著缩短行驶时间、减少启停次数和能耗。
AI.research_question: 如何在复杂交通环境下为燃料电池混合动力电动汽车设计有效的生态驾驶策略，实现行驶时间、能耗和部件老化的多目标优化？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多集中于跟车场景下的速度规划与能量管理耦合，对燃料电池混合动力电动汽车在复杂交通环境中的相关研究仍存在不足，需要开发更有效的生态驾驶策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于模型预测控制（MPC）框架的多目标优化理论，结合深度强化学习（DRL）中的TD3算法，引入自适应噪声机制，构建分层控制架构。
AI.method: 采用分层策略：1）基于真实交通场景构建驾驶环境模型，考虑信号交叉口等路况信息求解通过参考速度；2）基于MPC框架构建多目标成本函数进行车速优化；3）提出改进的自适应噪声TD3（AN-TD3）算法，设计考虑氢耗成本和部件老化的综合奖励函数，实现燃料电池与锂电池的功率分配优化。使用MATLAB/Simulink和SUMO进行联合仿真验证。
AI.findings: 所提策略显著缩短行驶时间、减少车辆启停次数和能耗；AN-TD3算法比传统DRL算法收敛更快，氢耗接近动态规划的全局最优，有效抑制燃料电池和锂电池老化，提高整车运行经济性和鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了集成速度规划和能量管理的分层生态驾驶策略框架；2）开发了改进的自适应噪声TD3（AN-TD3）算法；3）构建了考虑氢耗成本和部件老化的综合奖励函数；4）为燃料电池混合动力电动汽车在复杂交通环境下的多目标优化提供了理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为燃料电池混合动力电动汽车提供了有效的生态驾驶解决方案；2）显著提升了车辆的经济性和鲁棒性；3）为实际交通环境中的智能网联车辆节能优化提供了技术参考；4）验证了所提策略在缩短行程时间、减少能耗和抑制部件老化方面的实际效果。

title: Hope, Noise, and the Efficiency of Perfect Meritocracy
affiliations: Università degli Studi di Genova and Università degli Studi di Genova

detail.title: Hope, Noise, and the Efficiency of Perfect Meritocracy
detail.abstract: This paper explores the economic effects of imperfect meritocracy in recruitment and career advancement. We compare two career promotion mechanisms: a fully meritocratic system and a "noisy" one, that allows a share of less productive workers to advance. Our model shows that imperfect meritocracy in promotions can boost worker effort through the "hope effect," potentially leading to higher aggregate output and total welfare compared to a strictly meritocratic system. Workers at the bottom of the skill distribution benefit most under this scenario, while the highest-skilled ones are worse off. We conclude that when perfect meritocracy in recruitment is unattainable, it may not be optimal to have it in career advancement, offering insights for economic policy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了招聘和职业晋升中不完全精英制度的经济效应。研究发现，允许部分低生产力员工晋升的"嘈杂"晋升机制，相比完全精英制度，能通过"希望效应"激励员工努力，可能带来更高的总产出和福利。
AI.research_question: 不完全精英制度在职业晋升中的经济效应是什么？与完全精英制度相比，允许部分低生产力员工晋升的"嘈杂"晋升机制如何影响员工努力、总产出和社会福利？
AI.motivation: 现实中完全精英制度难以实现，组织往往存在晋升决策中的"噪音"。研究这种不完全精英制度的经济效应，有助于理解何时追求完全精英制度是最优的，为经济政策提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不完全信息下的激励理论，引入"希望效应"概念。该理论认为，当晋升不完全基于绩效时，低技能员工看到晋升机会，会提高努力水平，从而产生正向激励效果。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含两种晋升机制的经济模型：完全精英制度和"嘈杂"晋升制度。通过比较静态分析，考察不同机制下员工努力、产出和福利的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 不完全精英制度通过"希望效应"能提高员工努力水平；2. 可能带来更高的总产出和总福利；3. 技能分布底层的员工受益最大；4. 最高技能员工福利受损；5. 当招聘无法实现完全精英时，晋升中也不应追求完全精英。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"希望效应"作为不完全精英制度下的激励机制；2. 挑战了"完全精英制度总是最优"的传统观点；3. 为组织设计和晋升政策提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织设计晋升制度提供指导：当无法实现完全精英招聘时，晋升制度应保留一定灵活性；2. 为政策制定者提供启示：追求完全精英可能不是最优选择；3. 帮助理解不同技能层次员工对晋升制度的反应差异。

title: A Cross-Sector Analysis of Cyber Hygiene: Private vs. Public
affiliations: University of Sarajevo, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Sarajevo and University of Sarajevo

detail.title: A Cross-Sector Analysis of Cyber Hygiene: Private vs. Public
detail.abstract: Cyber hygiene in both the public and private sector is increasingly recognized as a critical discipline, yet both domains face challenges in translating knowledge and awareness into consistent behavioral practices. Public and private sectors differ in how cyber hygiene awareness, knowledge, and behavior are fostered, with public institutions often constrained by bureaucracy and limited resources, while private organizations benefit from agility, accountability, and stronger investment in training. These contrasts motivated the need to investigate whether differences exist in cyber hygiene awareness, behavior, and knowledge between the two sectors. The results of this study, that tested if the differences exist, show that there is no significant difference in levels of cyber hygiene awareness, behavior, and knowledge between public and private sector. By examining cyber hygiene across both sectors within a unified methodological framework, the study offers insights into universal challenges that organizations face in improving employee security behaviour, suggesting that interventions should prioritize training, organizational culture, and behaviour-focused strategies rather than sector-specific measures. This is the first such comprehensive study comparing cyber hygiene levels in both working sectors and the obtained findings have several security, organizational, technological, business, educational, and individual implications.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了公共和私营部门在网络安全卫生（意识、知识和行为）方面的差异，发现两者之间没有显著差异，建议采取通用的培训、组织文化和行为策略来改善员工安全行为。
AI.research_question: 公共部门和私营部门在网络安全卫生意识、知识和行为方面是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 公共和私营部门在培养网络安全卫生方面存在差异：公共部门受官僚主义和资源限制，私营部门则更具灵活性、问责制和培训投资。这些差异促使研究两个部门在网络安全卫生方面是否存在实际差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络安全卫生理论、组织行为理论、部门差异理论（公共vs私营）、知识-意识-行为转化理论
AI.method: 采用统一的方法论框架，通过实证研究比较两个部门的网络安全卫生水平
AI.findings: 研究发现公共部门和私营部门在网络安全卫生意识、知识和行为水平上没有显著差异
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次全面比较两个工作部门的网络安全卫生水平；2. 挑战了关于部门差异的传统假设；3. 提供了跨部门网络安全卫生的统一理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议优先考虑培训、组织文化和行为策略而非部门特定措施；2. 为组织改善员工安全行为提供通用干预方案；3. 对安全、组织、技术、商业、教育和个体层面都有实际意义

title: A Survey on Key Issues of Risk Assessment methods for Industrial Control System Security and Safety
affiliations: University of Information Engineering and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Survey on Key Issues of Risk Assessment methods for Industrial Control System Security and Safety
detail.abstract: With the deep integration of industrialization and informatization, the Industrial Control System (ICS) is facing more new threats and risks while improving its efficiency, safety risk and security risk can interact with each other, purely safety risk assessment or security risk assessment of the system no longer meets the needs, and there is an urgent need to carry out research on risk assessment of security and safety. Firstly, This paper systematically analyzes typical international standards and national standards, they form the basis of security and safety risk assessment methods; Then, based on this, analyze the key issues identified in the ICS security and safety risk assessment method: definition of security and safety risk, analysis of risk propagation path, calculation of risk propagation path likelihood, and quantification of event losses. Among them, risk definition is the foundation; This is followed by a comprehensive and systematic overview of the current state of research on these four key issues, and a further distillation of the results; Finally, current research challenges and future directions for security and safety risk assessment are envisioned.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了工业控制系统安全与安全风险评估的关键问题，包括风险定义、传播路径分析、可能性计算和损失量化，并展望了未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 工业控制系统安全与安全风险评估面临哪些关键问题？如何解决这些问题？
AI.motivation: 随着工业化与信息化的深度融合，工业控制系统面临新的威胁和风险，单纯的安全风险评估或安全风险评估已不能满足需求，亟需开展安全与安全风险评估研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际标准和国家标准的安全与安全风险评估方法框架，重点关注风险定义、传播路径分析、可能性计算和损失量化四个关键问题。
AI.method: 系统分析典型国际标准和国家标准，识别关键问题，全面梳理相关研究现状，提炼研究成果，最后展望研究挑战和未来方向。
AI.findings: 识别了工业控制系统安全与安全风险评估的四个关键问题：风险定义是基础，传播路径分析、可能性计算和损失量化是核心环节。现有研究在这些方面已有一定进展但仍面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了安全与安全风险评估的理论基础，明确了四个关键问题之间的逻辑关系，为后续研究提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业控制系统风险评估实践提供了方法指导，帮助识别评估过程中的关键环节，提高风险评估的全面性和准确性。

title: On green reputation: Green commitment versus greenwashing
affiliations: IMUVa. Departamento Economía Aplicada, Universidad de Valladolid, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: On green reputation: Green commitment versus greenwashing
detail.abstract: The paper studies a Cournot differential game between a brown firm, which produces business as usual, and a green firm, which uses a greener production technology. The greater the green efficiency, the more costly the green production, but also the faster the accumulation of green reputation, particularly when the pollution stock is high. Reputation growth also responds to greenwashing, defined by misleading green advertising. Reputation determines the size of a premium price. The green firm chooses the state-dependent optimal greenwashing and the once-and-for-all efficiency of the green technology. Convergence is oscillating, especially when consumers' trust in advertising (and hence greenwashing effectiveness) is low. A low greenwashing effectiveness also induces the firm to choose a more efficient green technology, raising green reputation and improving the environment. Interestingly, a mixed market, composed of a green and a brown firm, does well in social welfare terms. Pollution is low, similar to a pure green economy, especially with low greenwashing effectiveness. The producers’ and the consumers’ surpluses are close to their high levels in the pure brown economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了绿色企业与棕色企业在Cournot微分博弈中的竞争。绿色企业选择最优的绿色技术效率和绿色漂洗策略，声誉积累影响溢价。研究发现低绿色漂洗有效性促使企业选择更高效的绿色技术，混合市场在社会福利方面表现良好。
AI.research_question: 绿色企业如何选择最优的绿色技术效率和绿色漂洗策略？混合市场（绿色与棕色企业并存）在社会福利、环境污染和企业竞争方面表现如何？
AI.motivation: 随着环保意识增强，绿色企业与传统棕色企业的竞争日益重要。绿色技术效率、绿色声誉积累和绿色漂洗行为对市场竞争、环境质量和社会福利的影响需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cournot微分博弈理论，绿色声誉积累模型，绿色漂洗（greenwashing）理论，消费者信任与广告有效性理论
AI.method: 采用Cournot微分博弈模型，分析绿色企业和棕色企业的动态竞争。绿色企业选择一次性技术效率和状态依赖的绿色漂洗策略，研究声誉积累、污染存量对竞争均衡的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 收敛过程呈现振荡特性，特别是当消费者对广告信任度（绿色漂洗有效性）较低时；2. 低绿色漂洗有效性促使企业选择更高效的绿色技术，提升绿色声誉并改善环境；3. 混合市场在社会福利方面表现良好，污染水平接近纯绿色经济；4. 生产者和消费者剩余接近纯棕色经济的高水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了包含绿色技术效率、绿色漂洗和声誉积累的Cournot微分博弈模型；2. 揭示了绿色漂洗有效性与绿色技术选择之间的权衡关系；3. 提出了混合市场在社会福利方面的理论优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供监管绿色广告的依据；2. 为企业选择绿色技术策略提供指导；3. 展示了混合市场结构在环境保护和经济效益方面的平衡优势。

title: Understanding how safety posters affect perception of safety culture using virtual reality
affiliations: Mississippi State University, Mississippi State University and Mississippi State University

detail.title: Understanding how safety posters affect perception of safety culture using virtual reality
detail.abstract: Poster campaigns have been widely studied as tools for raising awareness and influencing attitudes, but their role in shaping perceptions of safety culture has not been examined. This study used virtual reality (VR) to evaluate how different types of workplace signage affect employees’ perceptions of safety. Participants experienced four simulated industrial environments: No Signage, Safety Signs, Safety Posters, and Safety Signs + Safety Posters. After viewing each environment, participants completed a ten-question survey assessing five dependent variables: perceived priority of safety, personal safety, coworker safety, safety awareness, and overall safety culture. Statistical analyses revealed significant differences across all five variables. In particular, conditions that included safety posters consistently produced higher ratings of safety culture compared to those with only required safety signs or no signage at all. These findings confirm the hypothesis that safety posters positively influence perceptions of safety culture in industrial environments. The results highlight both the value of VR as a methodological tool for studying workplace interventions and the potential of safety posters as a low-cost, practical means to enhance organizational safety culture.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用虚拟现实技术评估不同类型工作场所标识对员工安全感知的影响，发现包含安全海报的环境能显著提升安全文化感知，证实安全海报作为低成本工具对组织安全文化的积极影响。
AI.research_question: 不同类型的工作场所安全标识（无标识、安全标志、安全海报、安全标志+安全海报）如何影响员工对安全文化的感知？
AI.motivation: 海报活动作为提高意识和影响态度的工具已被广泛研究，但其在塑造安全文化感知方面的作用尚未得到检验。本研究旨在填补这一研究空白，探索安全标识对工作场所安全文化感知的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于安全文化理论和环境心理学，探讨物理环境标识如何影响员工的心理感知和行为态度，特别是安全标识作为环境线索对安全文化构建的作用机制。
AI.method: 采用虚拟现实实验方法，让参与者在四种模拟工业环境中体验：无标识、安全标志、安全海报、安全标志+安全海报。每个环境后完成十项问卷调查，评估五个因变量：安全优先级感知、个人安全、同事安全、安全意识、整体安全文化。
AI.findings: 统计分析显示五个变量均存在显著差异。特别是包含安全海报的条件相比仅含必需安全标志或无标识的条件，持续产生更高的安全文化评分。结果证实了安全海报对工业环境安全文化感知的积极影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统检验安全海报对安全文化感知的影响；2) 验证了虚拟现实作为研究工作场所干预方法学工具的价值；3) 扩展了环境标识对组织文化影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为组织提供了低成本、实用的安全文化提升工具；2) 证实安全海报作为补充性安全干预措施的有效性；3) 展示了VR技术在安全培训和环境设计评估中的实际应用价值。

title: Research on Thermal Power Prediction Technology of Qinshan NPP Based on Thermo-Enhanced-LSTM model
affiliations: Harbin Engineering University, Harbin Engineering University, Harbin Engineering University, Harbin Engineering University - Heilongjiang Provincial Key Laboratory of Nuclear Power System and Equipment and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Research on Thermal Power Prediction Technology of Qinshan NPP Based on Thermo-Enhanced-LSTM model
detail.abstract: Nuclear power plant operators frequently have difficulty to capture the time-dependent and nonlinear behaviors essential in reactor operation due to the complexity of the NPP systems. Accurate thermal power prediction is important for efficiency and safety of the reactor. This research presents Thermo-Enhanced-LSTM model which is a Deep learning approach designed to overcome these limitations. The model uses real-time operational data from the Qinshan 300MWe NPP and predicts the Thermal power under different operational conditions (full power, partial power, startup, and shutdown). The enhanced LSTM architecture, coupled with preprocessing techniques, ensures robust performance even in noisy conditions. Results indicates the accuracy of the model. Mean Squared Error (MSE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and R2 are the evaluation metrics of the model, with findings indicating excellent performance, particularly during shutdown conditions (MSE: 0.003, RMSE: 0.0165, R²: 0.9997). This study offers insightful information regarding AI-driven predictive modeling, enhancing NPP safety, efficiency, and operational decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于深度学习的Thermo-Enhanced-LSTM模型，用于预测核电站热功率，解决了传统方法难以捕捉时间依赖性和非线性行为的问题，在秦山300MWe核电站数据上表现出优异性能。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够准确预测核电站热功率的深度学习模型，特别是在复杂、动态的操作条件下？
AI.motivation: 核电站系统复杂，传统方法难以捕捉时间依赖性和非线性行为，而准确的热功率预测对反应堆效率和安全性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习理论，特别是长短期记忆网络（LSTM）架构，用于处理时间序列数据和捕捉长期依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出Thermo-Enhanced-LSTM模型，使用秦山300MWe核电站的实时运行数据，在不同操作条件（满功率、部分功率、启动、停机）下进行热功率预测，采用预处理技术处理噪声数据。
AI.findings: 模型表现出优异的预测性能，特别是在停机条件下（MSE: 0.003, RMSE: 0.0165, R²: 0.9997），验证了模型在不同操作条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了增强的LSTM架构，扩展了深度学习在核电站热功率预测领域的应用，为处理复杂时间序列数据提供了新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为核电站运营商提供了准确的热功率预测工具，有助于提高反应堆安全性、效率和操作决策质量，特别是在动态操作条件下。

title: SMA-CPO-Levy: A Hybrid Metaheuristic Combining CPO Foraging and Lévy Flight for Optimizing Green Cold Chain Logistics with Time Windows
affiliations: Tianjin University of Commerce and Tianjin University of Commerce

detail.title: SMA-CPO-Levy: A Hybrid Metaheuristic Combining CPO Foraging and Lévy Flight for Optimizing Green Cold Chain Logistics with Time Windows

keywords: Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (VRPTW)

detail.abstract: Optimizing the Green Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (G-VRPTW) for cold chain logistics constitutes a formidable combinatorial challenge, necessitating the simultaneous balance of three frequently conflicting objectives: economic efficiency, environmental sustainability, and product quality integrity. This work advances the field through three key contributions. First, we introduce a comprehensive mathematical model that integrates six critical cost components—fixed vehicle, transportation, refrigeration energy, cargo deterioration, carbon emission, and time-window penalties—into a unified optimization framework. Second, we develop SMA-CPO-Levy, a novel hybrid metaheuristic that combines SMA’s oscillatory search behavior, CPO’s cognitive-social foraging mechanisms, and Lévy flight’s long-range exploration capability. Third, through a rigorous, multi-tiered experimental evaluation, we establish the statistically significant superiority of SMA-CPO-Levy over six state-of-the-art algorithms. On 23 benchmark functions, SMA-CPO-Levy achieves optimal solutions on 78% of test cases with convergence rates 30-50% faster than competitors. For Solomon VRPTW instances, our algorithm reduces total costs by 53.3-77.2% (p < 0.001) compared to HHO, MPA, and IGA-ACO. In an industrial case study with a Chinese cold chain enterprise, SMA-CPO-Levy yields 10.8% overall cost reduction, including 8.7% refrigeration energy savings and 12.4% carbon emission reduction. These findings establish SMA-CPO-Levy as both a theoretical advancement in metaheuristic design and a practical decision-support tool for sustainable logistics planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SMA-CPO-Levy的新型混合元启发式算法，用于优化冷链物流中的绿色车辆路径问题。该算法结合了三种搜索策略，在23个基准函数上实现了78%的最优解，收敛速度比竞争对手快30-50%。在实际应用中，该算法能显著降低总成本、制冷能耗和碳排放。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种有效的优化算法来解决冷链物流中的绿色车辆路径问题，同时平衡经济效率、环境可持续性和产品质量完整性这三个经常冲突的目标？
AI.motivation: 冷链物流中的绿色车辆路径问题是一个复杂的组合优化挑战，需要同时考虑经济成本、环境影响和产品质量。现有算法难以有效平衡这三个经常冲突的目标，因此需要开发更先进的优化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色车辆路径问题、多目标优化理论、元启发式算法设计、可持续物流理论
AI.method: 1. 建立包含六个成本组件的综合数学模型；2. 开发SMA-CPO-Levy混合元启发式算法，结合SMA的振荡搜索、CPO的认知-社会觅食机制和Lévy飞行的长距离探索能力；3. 进行多层次的实验评估，包括基准函数测试、Solomon VRPTW实例验证和工业案例研究。
AI.findings: 1. 在23个基准函数上，SMA-CPO-Levy在78%的测试案例中实现了最优解，收敛速度比竞争对手快30-50%；2. 对于Solomon VRPTW实例，相比HHO、MPA和IGA-ACO算法，总成本降低了53.3-77.2%；3. 在中国冷链企业的工业案例中，实现了10.8%的总成本降低，包括8.7%的制冷能耗节约和12.4%的碳排放减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个整合六个关键成本组件的综合数学模型；2. 开发了SMA-CPO-Levy这一新型混合元启发式算法，为元启发式算法设计提供了理论创新；3. 通过严格的实验验证了算法的统计显著优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为冷链物流企业提供了有效的决策支持工具；2. 能够显著降低运营成本、能源消耗和环境影响；3. 为可持续物流规划提供了实用的解决方案。

title: A state-degradation-risk-embedded sliding mode perimeter control for regional road networks under cyberattacks
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology, Monash University, Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology and Hefei University of Technology

detail.title: A state-degradation-risk-embedded sliding mode perimeter control for regional road networks under cyberattacks
detail.abstract: With the gradual popularization of connected and automated vehicle (CAV) technologies, urban traffic systems increasingly rely on communication networks to achieve vehicle-infrastructure cooperation and cloud-based control. However, when communication networks suffer from cyberattacks, non-linear changes in the macroscopic traffic flow characteristics are induced, which result in traffic network capacity attenuation and throughput degradation. To resist the adverse effects of cyberattacks on network traffic states, this paper proposes a state-degradation-risk-embedded sliding mode perimeter (SDRE-SMP) control approach based on the macroscopic fundamental diagram (MFD) theory. First, the network traffic flow is divided into five states through fuzzy inference based on MFD characteristics. On this basis, the "state risk flow" is introduced to accurately quantify the disruption caused by cyberattacks to the supply-demand balance. Second, according to the vehicle accumulation ratio and risk flow intensity, a dynamic state transition probability matrix is constructed to predict the risk probability of the network state transitioning to a deteriorated state. A comprehensive state degradation risk index is then formulated by assigning differentiated weights. Third, target vehicle accumulation is dynamically adjusted based on the network state degradation condition, and a regional sliding mode perimeter controller incorporating the comprehensive degradation risk index is developed. Finally, in a scenario of a 9×9 grid road network with a central 4×4 grid region under four different cyberattack modes, four control methods are tested: no control, PI control, model predictive control (MPC) with dynamic target vehicle accumulation, and SDRE-SMP control. Comparison results demonstrate that SDRE-SMP control can effectively suppress the regional MFD capacity attenuation and traffic congestion caused by cyberattacks. These results suggest that the proposed approach can not only improve traffic flow operational efficiency but also significantly reduce total delay and lower carbon emissions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于宏观基本图理论的状态退化风险嵌入式滑模边界控制方法，用于抵抗网络攻击对城市交通系统的影响，通过动态调整目标车辆积累量和风险指标，有效抑制网络攻击导致的交通拥堵和容量衰减。
AI.research_question: 如何有效抵抗网络攻击对联网自动驾驶车辆交通系统的影响，防止交通网络容量衰减和吞吐量下降？
AI.motivation: 随着联网自动驾驶车辆技术的普及，城市交通系统越来越依赖通信网络实现车路协同和云端控制，但网络攻击会导致宏观交通流特性非线性变化，造成交通网络容量衰减和吞吐量下降。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观基本图理论、模糊推理、状态风险流概念、动态状态转移概率矩阵、滑模控制理论
AI.method: 1. 基于MFD特性通过模糊推理将网络交通流分为五种状态；2. 引入"状态风险流"量化网络攻击对供需平衡的破坏；3. 构建动态状态转移概率矩阵预测状态恶化风险；4. 制定综合状态退化风险指标；5. 开发包含综合退化风险指标的区域滑模边界控制器；6. 在9×9网格路网场景下测试四种控制方法。
AI.findings: 在四种不同网络攻击模式下，SDRE-SMP控制能有效抑制区域MFD容量衰减和交通拥堵，相比无控制、PI控制、MPC控制，能提高交通流运行效率，显著减少总延误并降低碳排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了状态风险流概念，用于量化网络攻击对交通系统供需平衡的破坏；2. 构建了动态状态转移概率矩阵，用于预测网络状态恶化风险；3. 开发了综合状态退化风险指标；4. 提出了状态退化风险嵌入式滑模边界控制框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为抵抗网络攻击对CAV交通系统的影响提供了有效的控制方法；2. 能提高交通流运行效率，减少延误；3. 有助于降低碳排放；4. 为智能交通系统的网络安全防护提供了技术方案。

title: Moral–Epistemic Worlds as a Unit of Leadership Analysis: Reframing Leadership Theory Through a Māori Case
affiliations: University of Auckland

detail.title: Moral–Epistemic Worlds as a Unit of Leadership Analysis: Reframing Leadership Theory Through a Māori Case
detail.abstract: This article advances leadership theory by redefining its unit of analysis. It introduces moral–epistemic worlds as a theoretically specified construct for analysing leadership as a culturally embedded and morally constituted practice. Existing approaches—including individual, role-based, and distributed models—remain limited because they insufficiently account for the historically constituted systems of meaning that shape what counts as knowledge, authority, and legitimate action.The article develops a theoretical progression from distributed leadership (Gronn), through pragmatic holism and non-foundational epistemology (Evers & Lakomski), to non-foundational discourse theory (Olssen), and extends this trajectory through Anonymous’s account of educative leadership as moral craftsmanship. Moral–epistemic worlds are defined as configurations of ontology, epistemology, ethics, practice, and pedagogy that condition leadership possibilities across contexts.A Māori case from Aotearoa New Zealand provides an analytically generative instance, illustrating how leadership is constituted through relational concepts including whakapapa, mana, and tikanga. The article contributes by re-specifying the unit of analysis, extending distributed leadership theory, and advancing a comparative, non-foundational methodology for analysing leadership across plural contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入"道德-认知世界"作为分析单位，重新定义了领导力理论，将领导力视为文化嵌入和道德构成的实践，并以新西兰毛利案例进行说明。
AI.research_question: 如何重新定义领导力的分析单位，以更好地解释领导力作为文化嵌入和道德构成的实践？
AI.motivation: 现有领导力理论（包括个体、角色和分布式模型）未能充分考虑塑造知识、权威和合法行动的历史构成意义系统，需要新的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式领导力（Gronn）、实用主义整体论和非基础主义认识论（Evers & Lakomski）、非基础主义话语理论（Olssen），以及教育领导力作为道德技艺的匿名理论。
AI.method: 理论构建与案例研究相结合，使用新西兰毛利文化（whakapapa、mana、tikanga等关系概念）作为分析生成性实例。
AI.findings: 领导力通过道德-认知世界构成，这些世界是本体论、认识论、伦理学、实践和教学法的配置，在不同情境中塑造领导可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新指定领导力分析单位；2. 扩展分布式领导力理论；3. 推进跨多元情境领导力分析的比较性、非基础主义方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同文化背景下的领导实践提供分析框架，特别有助于跨文化领导力研究和实践。

title: The Wisdom Woods: Leadership Transformation as Inferential Meaning-Making Through Allegorical Autoethnography
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Wisdom Woods: Leadership Transformation as Inferential Meaning-Making Through Allegorical Autoethnography
detail.abstract: This study examines leadership transformation through an allegorical autoethnographic approach that integrates narrative inquiry with inferential pragmatics and social identity leadership theory. Grounded in Relevance Theory, meaning is conceptualized as emergent, produced through context-sensitive inference rather than the transmission of fixed ideas. The allegorical narrative presents leadership as a relational, identity-based process shaped by tensions between fear-based control and trust-based engagement. Through indeterminacy the narrative invites active interpretation, positioning meaning as co-constructed between text and reader. The study advances a novel theoretical account of leadership as inferential meaning-making by integrating Relevance Theory with social identity approaches through allegorical autoethnography as an analytic method. This transformation illustrates how leadership identity is reconstructed through reflexive engagement, relational accountability, and alignment with shared group norms and values. Allegory operates as both a method and an analytic strategy, enabling the examination of complex emotional and ethical experience while preserving contextual integrity.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用寓言式自传民族志方法，结合叙事探究、推理语用学和社会认同领导理论，探讨领导力转型。研究将意义视为在语境敏感推理中涌现的，而非固定观念的传递，提出领导力是一种基于身份的关系过程，在恐惧控制和信任参与之间的张力中形成。
AI.research_question: 领导力如何通过寓言式自传民族志方法实现转型？意义如何在领导力身份重构过程中通过推理意义建构而涌现？
AI.motivation: 传统领导力研究往往将意义视为固定观念的传递，缺乏对意义在语境中动态建构过程的关注。需要整合叙事探究、语用学和社会认同理论，以更全面地理解领导力作为关系性和身份性过程的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关联理论（Relevance Theory）、社会认同领导理论、叙事探究、推理语用学、寓言式自传民族志
AI.method: 寓言式自传民族志方法，结合叙事探究和推理语用学分析，通过不确定性叙事邀请主动解读，将意义定位为文本与读者共同建构
AI.findings: 领导力是一种基于身份的关系过程，在恐惧控制和信任参与之间的张力中形成；领导力身份通过反思性参与、关系责任和对共享群体规范与价值观的调整而重构；寓言既作为方法又作为分析策略，能够检验复杂的情感和伦理体验，同时保持语境完整性
AI.theory_contributions: 通过整合关联理论与社会认同方法，提出领导力作为推理意义建构的新理论解释；发展了寓言式自传民族志作为分析方法的理论框架；推进了对领导力作为关系性、身份性过程的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导力发展提供基于反思性参与和关系责任的实际方法；通过寓言叙事帮助领导者理解复杂情感和伦理体验；为组织中的领导力转型提供基于信任参与而非恐惧控制的实践指导
